"""
AttendSure - Color Terminal Request Logger Middleware
File: backend/apps/api/color_logger.py

Formats terminal output with ANSI colors to visually highlight:
- CRUD actions: [CREATE], [READ], [UPDATE], [DELETE]
- Health indicators: Working (Green), Client Error (Yellow), Server Crash (Red)
- Dims background SMS queue polling to keep console clean.
"""

import time
from django.utils import timezone


class TerminalColors:
    RESET = "\033[0m"
    BOLD = "\033[1m"
    DIM = "\033[2m"

    # Foreground
    RED = "\033[91m"
    GREEN = "\033[92m"
    YELLOW = "\033[93m"
    BLUE = "\033[94m"
    MAGENTA = "\033[95m"
    CYAN = "\033[96m"
    WHITE = "\033[97m"

    # Background
    BG_RED = "\033[41m\033[97m\033[1m"
    BG_YELLOW = "\033[43m\033[30m\033[1m"
    BG_GREEN = "\033[42m\033[30m\033[1m"


class ColorTerminalMiddleware:
    def __init__(self, get_response):
        self.get_response = get_response

    def __call__(self, request):
        start_time = time.time()
        response = self.get_response(request)
        duration_ms = int((time.time() - start_time) * 1000)

        self.log_request(request, response, duration_ms)
        return response

    def log_request(self, request, response, duration_ms):
        method = request.method
        path = request.path
        code = response.status_code
        now_str = timezone.localtime().strftime("%H:%M:%S")

        # 1. Background daemon polling filter (dimmed so it does not clutter terminal)
        if path == "/api/sms/pending/" and code == 200:
            print(
                f"{TerminalColors.DIM}[{now_str}] [SMS-POLL] GET {path} -> 200 OK ({duration_ms}ms){TerminalColors.RESET}"
            )
            return

        # 2. CRUD Action Tag & Color
        if method == "POST":
            crud_badge = f"{TerminalColors.GREEN}{TerminalColors.BOLD}[CREATE]{TerminalColors.RESET}"
            method_str = f"{TerminalColors.GREEN}{method}{TerminalColors.RESET}"
        elif method == "GET":
            crud_badge = f"{TerminalColors.CYAN}{TerminalColors.BOLD}[READ]  {TerminalColors.RESET}"
            method_str = f"{TerminalColors.CYAN}{method}{TerminalColors.RESET}"
        elif method in ("PUT", "PATCH"):
            crud_badge = f"{TerminalColors.YELLOW}{TerminalColors.BOLD}[UPDATE]{TerminalColors.RESET}"
            method_str = f"{TerminalColors.YELLOW}{method}{TerminalColors.RESET}"
        elif method == "DELETE":
            crud_badge = f"{TerminalColors.MAGENTA}{TerminalColors.BOLD}[DELETE]{TerminalColors.RESET}"
            method_str = f"{TerminalColors.MAGENTA}{method}{TerminalColors.RESET}"
        else:
            crud_badge = f"{TerminalColors.WHITE}[OTHER] {TerminalColors.RESET}"
            method_str = method

        # 3. Status Code Badge & Health Color
        if 200 <= code < 300:
            status_badge = f"{TerminalColors.GREEN}{TerminalColors.BOLD}[WORKING {code}]{TerminalColors.RESET}"
        elif 300 <= code < 400:
            status_badge = f"{TerminalColors.CYAN}[REDIRECT {code}]{TerminalColors.RESET}"
        elif code in (401, 403):
            status_badge = f"{TerminalColors.BG_YELLOW} [DENIED {code}] {TerminalColors.RESET}"
        elif 400 <= code < 500:
            status_badge = f"{TerminalColors.YELLOW}{TerminalColors.BOLD}[BAD REQUEST {code}]{TerminalColors.RESET}"
        elif code >= 500:
            status_badge = f"{TerminalColors.BG_RED} [SERVER CRASH {code}] {TerminalColors.RESET}"
        else:
            status_badge = f"[{code}]"

        # 4. Authenticated User Identity
        user = getattr(request, "user", None)
        if user and user.is_authenticated:
            user_label = f"{TerminalColors.WHITE}(User: {user.username}){TerminalColors.RESET}"
        else:
            user_label = f"{TerminalColors.DIM}(Anon/Hardware){TerminalColors.RESET}"

        # 5. Latency badge
        if duration_ms > 500:
            latency_badge = f"{TerminalColors.RED}{duration_ms}ms (SLOW){TerminalColors.RESET}"
        else:
            latency_badge = f"{TerminalColors.DIM}{duration_ms}ms{TerminalColors.RESET}"

        # Print unified colored log line
        print(
            f"[{now_str}] {crud_badge} {status_badge} {method_str} {path} {user_label} {latency_badge}"
        )

FILE: backend\apps\api\middleware.py

import os
import sys
import time

# Enable native ANSI VT100 color support in Windows PowerShell / Command Prompt
if sys.platform == 'win32':
    os.system('')

class ColoredAPILoggingMiddleware:
    """
    Colorizes terminal output for all HTTP requests:
    - 2xx / 3xx (OK): Bright GREEN
    - 4xx / 5xx (Bugs / Errors): Bright RED
    """
    # ANSI escape color codes
    GREEN = '\033[92m'
    RED = '\033[91m'
    BOLD = '\033[1m'
    RESET = '\033[0m'
    DIM = '\033[2m'

    def __init__(self, get_response):
        self.get_response = get_response

    def __call__(self, request):
        start_time = time.time()
        
        response = self.get_response(request)
        
        duration_ms = (time.time() - start_time) * 1000
        status_code = response.status_code
        method = request.method
        full_path = request.get_full_path()
        time_str = time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')

        # Determine color based on HTTP status code
        if status_code < 400:
            # OK (Green)
            color = self.GREEN
            tag = "✓ OK"
        else:
            # Bug or Error (Red)
            color = self.RED
            tag = "✗ ERROR"

        log_output = (
            f"{color}{self.BOLD}[{time_str}] [{tag} {status_code}] "
            f"{method:<6} {full_path} {self.DIM}({duration_ms:.1f}ms){self.RESET}"
        )

        print(log_output, flush=True)
        return response

    def process_exception(self, request, exception):
        """Catches uncaught 500 exceptions and prints in Bright Red with traceback hint"""
        time_str = time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')
        print(
            f"{self.RED}{self.BOLD}[{time_str}] [✗ BUG 500] "
            f"{request.method} {request.get_full_path()} -> EXCEPTION: {exception}{self.RESET}",
            flush=True
        )

"""
AttendSure - Resilient API Pagination
File: backend/apps/api/pagination.py
"""

from rest_framework.pagination import PageNumberPagination
from rest_framework.response import Response


class StandardResultsSetPagination(PageNumberPagination):
    page_size = 25
    page_size_query_param = 'page_size'
    max_page_size = 10000

    def get_page_size(self, request):
        if self.page_size_query_param:
            param = request.query_params.get(self.page_size_query_param)
            if param:
                clean_param = str(param).strip().upper()
                if clean_param in ('ALL', 'MAX', 'NONE'):
                    return self.max_page_size
                try:
                    val = int(clean_param)
                    if val > 0:
                        return min(val, self.max_page_size)
                except (ValueError, TypeError):
                    pass
        return self.page_size

    def get_paginated_response(self, data):
        return Response({
            'count': self.page.paginator.count,
            'total_pages': self.page.paginator.num_pages,
            'current_page': self.page.number,
            'page_size': self.get_page_size(self.request),
            'next': self.get_next_link(),
            'previous': self.get_previous_link(),
            'results': data
        })

"""
AttendSure V3 - Reusable Cybersecurity & Permission Classes
File: backend/apps/api/permissions.py
"""

from rest_framework import permissions
from apps.common.utils import get_user_role, is_leadership_role


class IsAdminUserOrReadOnly(permissions.BasePermission):
    """Allows full access to System Admins; read-only access to others."""
    def has_permission(self, request, view):
        if not (request.user and request.user.is_authenticated):
            return False
        if request.method in permissions.SAFE_METHODS:
            return True
        return request.user.is_superuser or get_user_role(request.user) in ('ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN')


class IsAcademicAdminOrReadOnly(permissions.BasePermission):
    """Allows full access to Principals, School Heads, and Admins; read-only to others."""
    def has_permission(self, request, view):
        if not (request.user and request.user.is_authenticated):
            return False
        if request.method in permissions.SAFE_METHODS:
            return True
        return request.user.is_superuser or is_leadership_role(request.user)


class IsStudentManagerOrReadOnly(permissions.BasePermission):
    """Allows student management only to Registrars, Principals, and Admins."""
    def has_permission(self, request, view):
        if not (request.user and request.user.is_authenticated):
            return False
        if request.method in permissions.SAFE_METHODS:
            return True
        return request.user.is_superuser or get_user_role(request.user) in (
            'ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL', 'REGISTRAR'
        )


class IsOwnerOrAdmin(permissions.BasePermission):
    """Allows users to view, update, and delete their own account; admins can manage all."""
    def has_permission(self, request, view):
        return bool(request.user and request.user.is_authenticated)

    def has_object_permission(self, request, view, obj):
        if request.user.is_superuser or get_user_role(request.user) == 'ADMIN':
            return True
        return obj.id == request.user.id

# Security controls: 5 MB cap defends against buffer overflow and memory denial-of-service
MAX_IMAGE_SIZE_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024
ALLOWED_IMAGE_EXTENSIONS = {'png', 'jpg', 'jpeg', 'webp'}


def ensure_user_profile_columns():
    """Database self-healing: ensures PostgreSQL user_profiles table has hybrid flags."""
    try:
        with connection.cursor() as cursor:
            cursor.execute("""
                ALTER TABLE user_profiles
                ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_teaching BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE;
            """)
            cursor.execute("""
                ALTER TABLE user_profiles
                ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_profile_completed BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE;
            """)
    except Exception:
        pass


def safe_photo_url(photo_field, request=None):
    """Converts image references safely into readable web URLs."""
    if not photo_field:
        return None
    try:
        if isinstance(photo_field, str):
            val = photo_field.strip()
            if not val or val.lower() in ('none', 'null', 'undefined'):
                return None
            if val.startswith(('http://', 'https://', 'data:image/')):
                return val
            if val.startswith('/media/') and request:
                return request.build_absolute_uri(val)
            return val

        if hasattr(photo_field, 'name') and photo_field.name:
            val_name = str(photo_field.name).strip()
            if val_name.startswith(('data:image/', 'http://', 'https://')):
                return val_name
            url = photo_field.url
            if request:
                return request.build_absolute_uri(url)
            return url
    except Exception:
        return None
    return None


class FlexibleImageField(serializers.Field):
    """Sanitizes incoming Base64 image files and rejects malicious payloads."""

    def to_representation(self, value):
        request = self.context.get('request')
        return safe_photo_url(value, request)

    def to_internal_value(self, data):
        if data in (None, '', 'null'):
            return None

        if hasattr(data, 'read'):
            if data.size > MAX_IMAGE_SIZE_BYTES:
                raise serializers.ValidationError("Image file size exceeds the 5 MB limit.")
            return data

        if isinstance(data, str):
            clean = data.strip()
            if not clean or clean.lower() in ('none', 'null', 'undefined'):
                return None

            if clean.startswith('data:image') and ';base64,' in clean:
                try:
                    header, img_str = clean.split(';base64,', 1)
                    raw_ext = header.split('/')[-1].split(';')[0].lower()
                    ext = 'jpg' if raw_ext in ('jpeg', 'pjpeg') else raw_ext

                    if ext not in ALLOWED_IMAGE_EXTENSIONS:
                        raise serializers.ValidationError(
                            f"Unsupported format (.{ext}). Allowed: PNG, JPG, WEBP."
                        )

                    decoded_data = base64.b64decode(img_str, validate=True)
                    if len(decoded_data) > MAX_IMAGE_SIZE_BYTES:
                        raise serializers.ValidationError("Decoded image exceeds the 5 MB limit.")

                    file_name = f"upload_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}.{ext}"
                    return ContentFile(decoded_data, name=file_name)
                except serializers.ValidationError:
                    raise
                except Exception as exc:
                    raise serializers.ValidationError(f"Invalid image data: {exc}")

            if clean.startswith(('http://', 'https://', '/media/')):
                raise serializers.SkipField()

        raise serializers.SkipField()

class ScheduleSerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer):
    section_name = serializers.CharField(source='section.name', read_only=True)
    subject_title = serializers.CharField(source='subject.title', read_only=True)
    subject_code = serializers.CharField(source='subject.code', read_only=True)
    faculty_name = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    days_of_week = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    schedule_code = serializers.SerializerMethodField()

    class Meta:
        model = Schedule
        fields = [
            'id',
            'schedule_code',
            'section',
            'section_id',
            'section_name',
            'subject',
            'subject_id',
            'subject_title',
            'subject_code',
            'faculty',
            'faculty_id',
            'faculty_name',
            'room_number',
            'days_of_week',
            'start_time',
            'end_time',
        ]

    def get_schedule_code(self, obj):
        return f"SCH-{obj.id:04d}"

    def get_faculty_name(self, obj):
        if getattr(obj, 'faculty', None):
            return obj.faculty.full_name
        return "Unassigned"

    def get_days_of_week(self, obj):
        days_qs = obj.days.all().order_by('day_of_week')
        if not days_qs.exists():
            return "MON-FRI"
        nums = [d.day_of_week for d in days_qs]
        if nums == [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]:
            return "MON-FRI"
        if nums == [1, 3, 5]:
            return "MWF"
        if nums == [2, 4]:
            return "TTH"
        if nums == [6]:
            return "SAT"
        labels = {1: 'MON', 2: 'TUE', 3: 'WED', 4: 'THU', 5: 'FRI', 6: 'SAT', 7: 'SUN'}
        return ",".join([labels.get(n, str(n)) for n in nums])

class StudentSerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer):
    full_name = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    current_section = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    section_id = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    photo = FlexibleImageField(required=False, allow_null=True)
    photo_url = serializers.SerializerMethodField()

    class Meta:
        model = Student
        fields = [
            'id',
            'lrn',
            'first_name',
            'middle_name',
            'last_name',
            'suffix',
            'full_name',
            'sex',
            'birthdate',
            'mother_tongue',
            'ethnic_group',
            'religion',
            'house_street_sitio',
            'barangay',
            'municipality_city',
            'province',
            'father_name',
            'mother_maiden_name',
            'guardian_name',
            'guardian_relationship',
            'parent_contact',
            'rfid_uid',
            'qr_token',
            'photo',
            'photo_url',
            'current_section',
            'section_id',
            'is_active',
        ]
        extra_kwargs = {
            'qr_token': {'required': False, 'allow_blank': True, 'allow_null': True},
            'rfid_uid': {'required': False, 'allow_blank': True, 'allow_null': True},
            'middle_name': {'required': False, 'allow_blank': True},
            'suffix': {'required': False, 'allow_blank': True},
            'parent_contact': {'required': False, 'allow_blank': True},
        }

    def validate_lrn(self, value):
        clean_lrn = value.strip()
        if not clean_lrn.isdigit():
            raise serializers.ValidationError("LRN must contain digits only.")
        return clean_lrn

    def validate_rfid_uid(self, value):
        if not value or not str(value).strip():
            return None
        return str(value).strip().upper()

    def validate_parent_contact(self, value):
        if not value:
            return ""
        return value.strip().replace(" ", "").replace("-", "")

    def get_full_name(self, obj):
        if hasattr(obj, 'full_name') and isinstance(obj.full_name, str):
            return obj.full_name
        mid = f" {obj.middle_name}" if getattr(obj, 'middle_name', None) else ""
        suf = f" {obj.suffix}" if getattr(obj, 'suffix', None) else ""
        return f"{obj.last_name}, {obj.first_name}{mid}{suf}".strip(" ,")

    def get_current_section(self, obj):
        enrollment = (
            obj.enrollments.filter(academic_year__is_active=True)
            .select_related('section', 'section__grade_level')
            .first()
        )
        if not enrollment:
            enrollment = obj.enrollments.select_related('section', 'section__grade_level').first()

        if enrollment and enrollment.section:
            sec_name = (enrollment.section.name or "").strip()
            grade_name = (
                enrollment.section.grade_level.name
                if enrollment.section.grade_level
                else ""
            ).strip()
            if not grade_name:
                return sec_name
            if not sec_name or grade_name.lower().endswith(sec_name.lower()):
                return grade_name
            return f"{grade_name} - {sec_name}"
        return "Unassigned"

    def get_section_id(self, obj):
        enrollment = obj.enrollments.filter(academic_year__is_active=True).first()
        if not enrollment:
            enrollment = obj.enrollments.first()
        return enrollment.section_id if enrollment else None

    def get_photo_url(self, obj):
        request = self.context.get('request')
        return safe_photo_url(getattr(obj, 'photo', None), request)

    def create(self, validated_data):
        if not validated_data.get('qr_token'):
            validated_data['qr_token'] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)

        student = super().create(validated_data)

        req_data = self.context.get('request').data if self.context.get('request') else {}
        sec_id = req_data.get('section_id') or req_data.get('section')
        if sec_id and str(sec_id).isdigit():
            section = Section.objects.filter(id=int(sec_id)).first()
            if section:
                ay = section.academic_year or AcademicYear.objects.filter(is_active=True).first()
                if ay:
                    Enrollment.objects.update_or_create(
                        student=student,
                        academic_year=ay,
                        defaults={'section': section, 'status': 'ENROLLED'},
                    )
        return student

    def update(self, instance, validated_data):
        student = super().update(instance, validated_data)
        req_data = self.context.get('request').data if self.context.get('request') else {}
        sec_id = req_data.get('section_id') or req_data.get('section')
        if sec_id and str(sec_id).isdigit():
            section = Section.objects.filter(id=int(sec_id)).first()
            if section:
                ay = section.academic_year or AcademicYear.objects.filter(is_active=True).first()
                if ay:
                    Enrollment.objects.update_or_create(
                        student=student,
                        academic_year=ay,
                        defaults={'section': section, 'status': 'ENROLLED'},
                    )
        return student

class GatePassSerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer):
    faculty_name = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    student_name = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    valid_until = serializers.DateTimeField(source='valid_to', required=False, allow_null=True)

    class Meta:
        model = GatePass
        fields = [
            'id',
            'pass_number',
            'faculty',
            'faculty_name',
            'student',
            'student_name',
            'issued_by',
            'pass_type',
            'reason',
            'valid_from',
            'valid_to',
            'valid_until',
            'status',
        ]
        # issued_by and pass_number are assigned automatically by the server
        read_only_fields = ['issued_by', 'pass_number', 'status']
        extra_kwargs = {
            'faculty': {'required': False, 'allow_null': True},
            'valid_from': {'required': False},
            'valid_to': {'required': False},
            'reason': {'required': False, 'allow_blank': True},
            'pass_type': {'required': False},
        }

    def to_internal_value(self, data):
        mutable_data = data.copy() if hasattr(data, 'copy') else dict(data)
        if 'valid_until' in mutable_data and not mutable_data.get('valid_to'):
            mutable_data['valid_to'] = mutable_data['valid_until']
        return super().to_internal_value(mutable_data)

    def get_faculty_name(self, obj):
        if getattr(obj, 'faculty', None):
            return obj.faculty.full_name
        if getattr(obj, 'issued_by', None):
            return getattr(obj.issued_by, 'full_name', str(obj.issued_by))
        return "School Staff"

    def get_student_name(self, obj):
        if getattr(obj, 'student', None):
            return obj.student.full_name
        return ""

    is_teaching = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    can_teach = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    is_profile_completed = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    faculty_id = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    photo = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    photo_url = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    password = serializers.CharField(write_only=True, required=False, allow_blank=True)

    class Meta:
        model = User
        fields = [
            'id',
            'username',
            'first_name',
            'last_name',
            'email',
            'role',
            'current_role',
            'is_teaching',
            'can_teach',
            'is_profile_completed',
            'faculty_id',
            'photo',
            'photo_url',
            'is_active',
            'is_staff',
            'is_superuser',
            'password',
        ]

    def _get_profile(self, obj):
        return getattr(obj, 'profile', None) or getattr(obj, 'userprofile', None)

    def get_role(self, obj):
        prof = self._get_profile(obj)
        if prof and getattr(prof, 'role', None):
            return str(prof.role).upper()
        if obj.is_superuser:
            return 'ADMIN'
        return 'FACULTY'

    def get_current_role(self, obj):
        role = self.get_role(obj)
        is_teach = self.get_is_teaching(obj)
        if role == 'ADMIN' and is_teach:
            return 'FACULTY_ADMIN'
        return role

    def get_is_teaching(self, obj):
        prof = self._get_profile(obj)
        if prof and hasattr(prof, 'is_teaching'):
            return bool(prof.is_teaching)
        return self.get_role(obj) == 'FACULTY'

    def get_can_teach(self, obj):
        prof = self._get_profile(obj)
        if prof and hasattr(prof, 'can_teach'):
            return bool(prof.can_teach)
        return self.get_is_teaching(obj)

    def get_is_profile_completed(self, obj):
        prof = self._get_profile(obj)
        if prof and hasattr(prof, 'is_profile_completed'):
            return bool(prof.is_profile_completed)
        return bool(obj.first_name and obj.last_name)

    def get_faculty_id(self, obj):
        prof = self._get_profile(obj)
        return getattr(prof, 'faculty_id', None) if prof else None

    def get_photo(self, obj):
        return self.get_photo_url(obj)

    def get_photo_url(self, obj):
        request = self.context.get('request')
        prof = self._get_profile(obj)
        if prof and getattr(prof, 'faculty', None) and prof.faculty.photo:
            return safe_photo_url(prof.faculty.photo, request)
        if prof and getattr(prof, 'avatar', None):
            return safe_photo_url(prof.avatar, request)
        return None

    def validate_password(self, value):
        if value:
            clean_pw = value.strip()
            if len(clean_pw) < 8:
                raise serializers.ValidationError("Password must be at least 8 characters long.")
            try:
                validate_password(clean_pw)
            except DjangoValidationError as exc:
                raise serializers.ValidationError(list(exc.messages))
            return clean_pw
        return value

    def _parse_role_and_teaching(self, req_data, default_role='FACULTY', default_teaching=True):
        raw_role = str(req_data.get('role', default_role)).strip().upper()

        if raw_role in ('FACULTY_ADMIN', 'FACULTY/ADMIN', 'ADMIN_FACULTY'):
            final_role = 'ADMIN'
            is_teaching = True
        elif raw_role == 'ADMIN':
            final_role = 'ADMIN'
            is_teaching = bool(req_data.get('is_teaching', False))
        elif raw_role == 'GUARD':
            final_role = 'GUARD'
            is_teaching = False
        elif raw_role == 'FACULTY':
            final_role = 'FACULTY'
            is_teaching = True
        elif raw_role in ('PRINCIPAL', 'DEPT_HEAD'):
            final_role = raw_role
            is_teaching = bool(req_data.get('is_teaching', default_teaching))
        else:
            final_role = 'FACULTY'
            is_teaching = True

        return final_role, is_teaching

    def _sync_faculty_and_photo(self, user, prof, final_role, is_teaching, req_data):
        if final_role == 'GUARD' and not is_teaching:
            return

        emp_id = user.username.strip().upper()
        faculty = getattr(prof, 'faculty', None)

        if not faculty:
            faculty = FacultyProfile.objects.filter(employee_id__iexact=emp_id).first()

        default_pos = 'Faculty I / Administrator' if (final_role == 'ADMIN' and is_teaching) else 'Faculty I'
        default_dept = 'Administration' if final_role == 'ADMIN' else 'Junior High School'

        if not faculty:
            faculty = FacultyProfile.objects.create(
                employee_id=emp_id,
                first_name=user.first_name or user.username.capitalize(),
                last_name=user.last_name or 'Faculty',
                email=user.email or '',
                position=default_pos,
                department=default_dept,
                qr_token=secrets.token_urlsafe(32),
                can_teach=is_teaching,
                is_active=user.is_active,
            )
        else:
            if user.first_name:
                faculty.first_name = user.first_name
            if user.last_name:
                faculty.last_name = user.last_name
            if user.email:
                faculty.email = user.email
            faculty.is_active = user.is_active
            faculty.can_teach = is_teaching

        raw_photo = req_data.get('photo')
        if raw_photo is not None:
            if raw_photo == '':
                faculty.photo = None
            elif isinstance(raw_photo, str) and raw_photo.startswith('data:image'):
                img_field = FlexibleImageField()
                content_file = img_field.to_internal_value(raw_photo)
                if content_file:
                    faculty.photo.save(content_file.name, content_file, save=False)

        faculty.save()
        prof.faculty = faculty

    def create(self, validated_data):
        ensure_user_profile_columns()
        req_data = self.context.get('request').data if self.context.get('request') else {}

        raw_password = validated_data.pop('password', None)
        password = raw_password if raw_password else secrets.token_urlsafe(12)

        final_role, is_teaching = self._parse_role_and_teaching(req_data)

        user = User(**validated_data)
        if final_role == 'ADMIN':
            user.is_staff = True
            user.is_superuser = True
        user.set_password(password)
        user.save()

        prof, _ = UserProfile.objects.get_or_create(user=user)
        prof.role = final_role
        prof.is_teaching = is_teaching
        prof.is_profile_completed = False

        self._sync_faculty_and_photo(user, prof, final_role, is_teaching, req_data)
        prof.save()
        return user

    def update(self, instance, validated_data):
        ensure_user_profile_columns()
        req_data = self.context.get('request').data if self.context.get('request') else {}

        password = validated_data.pop('password', None)
        for attr, val in validated_data.items():
            setattr(instance, attr, val)

        prof, _ = UserProfile.objects.get_or_create(user=instance)

        if 'role' in req_data or 'is_teaching' in req_data:
            final_role, is_teaching = self._parse_role_and_teaching(
                req_data,
                default_role=prof.role or 'FACULTY',
                default_teaching=getattr(prof, 'is_teaching', True),
            )
            prof.role = final_role
            prof.is_teaching = is_teaching
            instance.is_staff = (final_role == 'ADMIN')
            instance.is_superuser = (final_role == 'ADMIN')
        else:
            final_role = prof.role or 'FACULTY'
            is_teaching = getattr(prof, 'is_teaching', True)

        if password:
            instance.set_password(password)
        instance.save()

        self._sync_faculty_and_photo(instance, prof, final_role, is_teaching, req_data)
        prof.save()
        return instance

def ensure_user_profile_schema():
    """Guarantees user_profiles table has the required columns in PostgreSQL."""
    try:
        with connection.cursor() as cursor:
            cursor.execute("""
                ALTER TABLE user_profiles
                ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_teaching BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE;
            """)
            cursor.execute("""
                ALTER TABLE user_profiles
                ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_profile_completed BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE;
            """)
            cursor.execute("""
                ALTER TABLE user_profiles
                ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS failed_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;
            """)
            cursor.execute("""
                ALTER TABLE user_profiles
                ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS locked_until TIMESTAMPTZ NULL;
            """)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.debug("Schema check for user_profiles: %s", e)


def ensure_faculty_profile_schema():
    """Guarantees faculty_profiles has the can_teach column enabled."""
    try:
        with connection.cursor() as cursor:
            cursor.execute("""
                ALTER TABLE faculty_profiles
                ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS can_teach BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE;
            """)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.debug("Schema check for faculty_profiles: %s", e)


def ensure_attendance_schema():
    ensure_user_profile_schema()
    ensure_faculty_profile_schema()
    try:
        with connection.cursor() as cursor:
            cursor.execute("""
                ALTER TABLE subject_attendance_logs
                ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS faculty_id INTEGER;
            """)
            cursor.execute("""
                DO $$
                BEGIN
                    IF EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns
                        WHERE table_name = 'subject_attendance_logs' AND column_name = 'teacher_id'
                    ) THEN
                        ALTER TABLE subject_attendance_logs ALTER COLUMN teacher_id DROP NOT NULL;
                    END IF;
                END $$;
            """)
            cursor.execute("""
                CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sync_subject_attendance_teacher()
                RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
                BEGIN
                    IF NEW.faculty_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.teacher_id IS NULL THEN
                        NEW.teacher_id := NEW.faculty_id;
                    ELSIF NEW.teacher_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.faculty_id IS NULL THEN
                        NEW.faculty_id := NEW.teacher_id;
                    END IF;
                    RETURN NEW;
                END;
                $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

                DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trg_sync_subject_attendance_teacher ON subject_attendance_logs;
                CREATE TRIGGER trg_sync_subject_attendance_teacher
                BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON subject_attendance_logs
                FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION sync_subject_attendance_teacher();
            """)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.debug("Schema check for subject_attendance_logs: %s", e)


def ensure_calendar_schema():
    with connection.cursor() as cursor:
        cursor.execute("""
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS attendsure_calendar_exceptions (
                id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
                exception_date DATE NOT NULL,
                exception_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SUSPENSION',
                reason VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
                affects_all_grades BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
                created_by_id INTEGER NULL,
                created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
            );
        """)
        cursor.execute("""
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS attendsure_calendar_settings (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT 1,
                weekend_rest_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
                updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
                CONSTRAINT single_row_check CHECK (id = 1)
            );
        """)
        cursor.execute("""
            INSERT INTO attendsure_calendar_settings (id, weekend_rest_enabled)
            VALUES (1, TRUE)
            ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;
        """)


def ensure_report_audit_schema():
    with connection.cursor() as cursor:
        cursor.execute("""
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS attendsure_report_audit_logs (
                id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
                user_id INTEGER NULL,
                username VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                report_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
                section_id INTEGER NULL,
                month INTEGER NULL,
                year INTEGER NULL,
                exported_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
            );
        """)


def record_report_audit_in_db(user, report_type, section_id=None, month=None, year=None):
    ensure_report_audit_schema()
    with connection.cursor() as cursor:
        cursor.execute("""
            INSERT INTO attendsure_report_audit_logs
                (user_id, username, report_type, section_id, month, year, exported_at)
            VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, NOW())
            RETURNING id, exported_at;
        """, [
            getattr(user, 'id', None),
            getattr(user, 'username', ''),
            str(report_type or 'REPORT').upper()[:30],
            int(section_id) if str(section_id or '').isdigit() else None,
            int(month) if str(month or '').isdigit() else None,
            int(year) if str(year or '').isdigit() else None,
        ])
        return cursor.fetchone()


def resolve_logo_field(val, request=None):
    """
    Saves large base64 logos to media files on disk once.
    Returns a lightweight URL to eliminate 15-second network timeouts.
    """
    if not val:
        return None
    val_str = str(val).strip()
    if not val_str or val_str.lower() in ('none', 'null', 'undefined'):
        return None

    # Already a standard URL or static media file path
    if val_str.startswith(('http://', 'https://', '/media/')):
        if val_str.startswith('/media/') and request:
            return request.build_absolute_uri(val_str)
        return val_str

    # Intercept large base64 image strings and offload them to disk
    if val_str.startswith('data:image/') or val_str.startswith(('/9j/', 'iVBORw0KGgo')):
        try:
            if ';base64,' in val_str:
                format_part, img_str = val_str.split(';base64,')
                ext = format_part.split('/')[-1].split(';')[0].lower()
                if ext in ('jpeg', 'pjpeg'):
                    ext = 'jpg'
            else:
                img_str = val_str
                ext = 'png'

            decoded_bytes = base64.b64decode(img_str, validate=True)
            if len(decoded_bytes) <= 10 * 1024 * 1024:
                file_hash = hashlib.md5(decoded_bytes).hexdigest()[:12]
                filename = f"logo_{file_hash}.{ext}"
                target_dir = os.path.join(settings.MEDIA_ROOT, 'school_logos')
                os.makedirs(target_dir, exist_ok=True)
                target_path = os.path.join(target_dir, filename)

                if not os.path.exists(target_path):
                    with open(target_path, 'wb') as f:
                        f.write(decoded_bytes)

                media_url = f"{settings.MEDIA_URL}school_logos/{filename}"
                return request.build_absolute_uri(media_url) if request else media_url
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error("Failed to save base64 logo to disk: %s", e)

    return val_str

# ============================================================================
# STRING FORMATTING & NAME HELPERS
# ============================================================================

def format_full_student_name(st):
    """Safely builds full student name: Last Name, First Name Middle Name Suffix."""
    if not st:
        return ""
    if hasattr(st, 'full_name') and isinstance(st.full_name, str):
        return st.full_name
    mid = f" {st.middle_name}" if getattr(st, 'middle_name', None) else ""
    suf = f" {st.suffix}" if getattr(st, 'suffix', None) else ""
    return f"{st.last_name}, {st.first_name}{mid}{suf}".strip(" ,")


def format_deduped_section_label(grade_name, section_name):
    """Formats section display label cleanly without duplicate text."""
    g = str(grade_name or '').strip()
    s = str(section_name or '').strip()
    if not g:
        return s
    if not s or g.lower().endswith(s.lower()) or f"- {s.lower()}" in g.lower():
        return g
    return f"{g} - {s}"


# ============================================================================
# ROLE, PERMISSION & ROW-LEVEL ISOLATION HELPERS
# ============================================================================

def get_user_profile(user):
    if not user:
        return None
    return getattr(user, 'profile', None) or getattr(user, 'userprofile', None)


def get_user_role(user):
    if not user or not user.is_authenticated:
        return None
    if user.is_superuser:
        return 'ADMIN'
    profile = get_user_profile(user)
    if profile and hasattr(profile, 'role') and profile.role:
        return str(profile.role).upper()
    return 'FACULTY'


def is_regular_faculty(role):
    return str(role or '').upper() in ['FACULTY', 'FACULTY']


def is_leadership_role(user):
    if not user or not user.is_authenticated:
        return False
    if user.is_superuser:
        return True
    return get_user_role(user) in ['ADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL', 'DEPT_HEAD']


def resolve_faculty_for_user(user):
    """Finds or links the active FacultyProfile for the authenticated user."""
    if not user or not user.is_authenticated:
        return None

    ensure_user_profile_schema()
    ensure_faculty_profile_schema()

    user_prof, _ = UserProfile.objects.get_or_create(user=user)
    faculty = getattr(user_prof, 'faculty', None)

    if not faculty:
        faculty = getattr(user, 'facultyprofile', None)

    if not faculty and user.email:
        faculty = FacultyProfile.objects.filter(email__iexact=user.email, is_active=True).first()

    if not faculty and user.first_name and user.last_name:
        faculty = FacultyProfile.objects.filter(
            first_name__iexact=user.first_name,
            last_name__iexact=user.last_name,
            is_active=True
        ).first()

    if not faculty:
        faculty = FacultyProfile.objects.filter(
            Q(employee_id__iexact=user.username) | Q(qr_token__iexact=user.username),
            is_active=True
        ).first()

    if not faculty:
        emp_id = str(user.username).strip().upper()
        faculty, _ = FacultyProfile.objects.get_or_create(
            employee_id=emp_id,
            defaults={
                'first_name': user.first_name or user.username.capitalize(),
                'last_name': user.last_name or 'Faculty',
                'email': user.email or '',
                'position': 'Faculty',
                'department': 'Academic Department',
                'qr_token': f"STF-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12].upper()}",
                'is_active': True,
                'can_teach': True,
            }
        )

    if faculty:
        f_updates = []
        if not getattr(faculty, 'is_active', True):
            faculty.is_active = True
            f_updates.append('is_active')
        if not getattr(faculty, 'can_teach', True):
            faculty.can_teach = True
            f_updates.append('can_teach')
        if f_updates:
            faculty.save(update_fields=f_updates)

        p_updates = []
        if getattr(user_prof, 'faculty_id', None) != faculty.id:
            user_prof.faculty = faculty
            p_updates.append('faculty')
        if not getattr(user_prof, 'is_teaching', True):
            user_prof.is_teaching = True
            p_updates.append('is_teaching')
        if p_updates:
            user_prof.save(update_fields=p_updates)

    return faculty


def get_faculty_section_ids(faculty) -> set:
    """
    Returns the exact set of Section IDs that a faculty member advises or teaches.
    Used to enforce Row-Level Data Isolation for regular faculty.
    """
    if not faculty:
        return set()
    advised_ids = set(Section.objects.filter(adviser=faculty).values_list('id', flat=True))
    scheduled_ids = set(Schedule.objects.filter(faculty=faculty).exclude(section__isnull=True).values_list('section_id', flat=True))
    return advised_ids.union(scheduled_ids)


def get_faculty_student_ids(faculty) -> set:
    """
    Returns the exact set of Student IDs enrolled in sections advised or taught by the faculty member.
    """
    sec_ids = get_faculty_section_ids(faculty)
    if not sec_ids:
        return set()
    return set(
        Enrollment.objects.filter(
            section_id__in=sec_ids,
            status__in=['ENROLLED', 'ACTIVE']
        ).values_list('student_id', flat=True).distinct()
    )


class IsSystemAdminRole(permissions.BasePermission):
    def has_permission(self, request, view):
        return bool(request.user and request.user.is_authenticated and get_user_role(request.user) == 'ADMIN')


class IsAdminOrPrincipalPermission(permissions.BasePermission):
    def has_permission(self, request, view):
        if not (request.user and request.user.is_authenticated):
            return False
        if request.method in permissions.SAFE_METHODS:
            return True
        return get_user_role(request.user) in ['ADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL']


class IsAcademicManagerPermission(permissions.BasePermission):
    def has_permission(self, request, view):
        if not (request.user and request.user.is_authenticated):
            return False
        if request.method in permissions.SAFE_METHODS:
            return True
        role = get_user_role(request.user)
        if request.method == 'DELETE':
            return role in ['ADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL']
        return role in ['ADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL', 'DEPT_HEAD']


class IsKioskAdminPermission(permissions.BasePermission):
    def has_permission(self, request, view):
        if not (request.user and request.user.is_authenticated):
            return False
        if request.method in permissions.SAFE_METHODS:
            return True
        return get_user_role(request.user) == 'ADMIN'


class GatePassPermission(permissions.BasePermission):
    def has_permission(self, request, view):
        if not (request.user and request.user.is_authenticated):
            return False
        role = get_user_role(request.user)
        # Guards cannot create or delete gate passes
        if role == 'GUARD' and request.method in ['POST', 'DELETE']:
            return False
        return True

    def has_object_permission(self, request, view, obj):
        if request.user.is_superuser:
            return True
        role = get_user_role(request.user)
        if role in ['ADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL', 'DEPT_HEAD']:
            return True
        if role == 'GUARD' and request.method in ['GET', 'PUT', 'PATCH']:
            return True
        user_faculty = resolve_faculty_for_user(request.user)
        if not user_faculty:
            return False
        allowed_student_ids = get_faculty_student_ids(user_faculty)
        return bool(
            obj.issued_by_id == user_faculty.id
            or obj.faculty_id == user_faculty.id
            or (obj.student_id and obj.student_id in allowed_student_ids)
        )


class SmsOutboxPermission(permissions.BasePermission):
    def has_permission(self, request, view):
        if not (request.user and request.user.is_authenticated):
            return False
        if request.user.is_superuser:
            return True
        role = get_user_role(request.user)
        return role in ['ADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL']


class IsAdviserOrAdmin(permissions.BasePermission):
    def has_permission(self, request, view):
        return bool(request.user and request.user.is_authenticated)

    def has_object_permission(self, request, view, obj):
        if not (request.user and request.user.is_authenticated):
            return False
        if is_leadership_role(request.user):
            return True
        faculty = resolve_faculty_for_user(request.user)
        if not faculty:
            return False
        if getattr(obj, 'adviser_id', None) == faculty.id:
            return True
        return Schedule.objects.filter(section=obj, faculty=faculty).exists()


class AuthLoginRateThrottle(AnonRateThrottle):
    rate = '10/minute'


class HardwareGateScanRateThrottle(AnonRateThrottle):
    rate = '180/minute'


class StandardResultsSetPagination(PageNumberPagination):
    page_size = 25
    page_size_query_param = 'page_size'
    max_page_size = 10000

    def get_page_size(self, request):
        raw_size = request.query_params.get(self.page_size_query_param, '')
        if str(raw_size).strip().upper() == 'ALL':
            return self.max_page_size
        return super().get_page_size(request)

    def get_paginated_response(self, data):
        return Response({
            'count': self.page.paginator.count,
            'total_pages': self.page.paginator.num_pages,
            'current_page': self.page.number,
            'next': self.get_next_link(),
            'previous': self.get_previous_link(),
            'results': data
        })


def verify_modem_gateway_request(request) -> bool:
    expected_token = getattr(settings, 'GSM_GATEWAY_TOKEN', None) or getattr(settings, 'SECRET_KEY', None)
    provided_key = request.headers.get('X-Modem-Key') or request.query_params.get('token')

    if provided_key and expected_token and hmac.compare_digest(provided_key.strip(), expected_token.strip()):
        return True

    if request.user and request.user.is_authenticated and get_user_role(request.user) in ['ADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL']:
        return True

    remote_ip = request.META.get('REMOTE_ADDR', '')
    if remote_ip in ('127.0.0.1', 'localhost', '::1'):
        return True

    return False

class FacultyClassroomClassListAPIView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request):
        ensure_attendance_schema()
        faculty = resolve_faculty_for_user(request.user)
        today_date = timezone.localdate()

        if is_leadership_role(request.user):
            schedules_qs = Schedule.objects.select_related(
                'section', 'section__grade_level', 'subject', 'faculty'
            ).all().order_by('start_time')
        elif faculty:
            schedules_qs = Schedule.objects.select_related(
                'section', 'section__grade_level', 'subject', 'faculty'
            ).filter(
                Q(faculty=faculty) | Q(section__adviser=faculty)
            ).distinct().order_by('start_time')
        else:
            return Response([], status=status.HTTP_200_OK)

        class_list_data = []
        for sched in schedules_qs:
            sec = sched.section
            if not sec:
                continue

            students = Student.objects.filter(
                enrollments__section=sec,
                is_active=True
            ).distinct().order_by('last_name', 'first_name')

            try:
                existing_logs = dict(
                    SubjectAttendanceLog.objects.filter(
                        schedule=sched,
                        attendance_date=today_date
                    ).values_list('student_id', 'status')
                )
            except Exception:
                existing_logs = {}

            grade_name = sec.grade_level.name if getattr(sec, 'grade_level', None) else ''

            student_items = []
            for st in students:
                photo_abs = safe_photo_url(st.photo, request)
                student_items.append({
                    'id': st.id,
                    'lrn': st.lrn,
                    'qr_token': st.qr_token or st.lrn,
                    'rfid_uid': st.rfid_uid or '',
                    'first_name': st.first_name,
                    'middle_name': st.middle_name or '',
                    'last_name': st.last_name,
                    'full_name': format_full_student_name(st),
                    'gender': getattr(st, 'sex', getattr(st, 'gender', '')),
                    'sex': getattr(st, 'sex', ''),
                    'photo': photo_abs,
                    'photo_url': photo_abs,
                    'parent_contact': st.parent_contact or '',
                    'guardian_name': st.guardian_name or '',
                    'attendance_status': existing_logs.get(st.id, 'UNSCANNED'),
                })

            class_list_data.append({
                'schedule_id': sched.id,
                'section_id': sec.id,
                'section_name': sec.name,
                'grade_level': grade_name,
                'display_section': format_deduped_section_label(grade_name, sec.name),
                'subject_name': getattr(sched.subject, 'title', getattr(sched.subject, 'name', '')) if sched.subject else '',
                'subject_code': getattr(sched.subject, 'code', '') if sched.subject else '',
                'faculty_name': sched.faculty.full_name if sched.faculty else '',
                'room': getattr(sched, 'room_number', '') or getattr(sec, 'room_number', '') or '',
                'start_time': str(sched.start_time) if getattr(sched, 'start_time', None) else '',
                'end_time': str(sched.end_time) if getattr(sched, 'end_time', None) else '',
                'total_students': len(student_items),
                'students': student_items,
            })

        return Response(class_list_data, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)


class ClassroomBatchScanAPIView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    @transaction.atomic
    def post(self, request):
        ensure_attendance_schema()
        serializer = ClassroomBatchScanSerializer(data=request.data)
        if not serializer.is_valid():
            return Response(serializer.errors, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)

        data = serializer.validated_data
        try:
            schedule = Schedule.objects.select_related('section', 'subject', 'faculty').get(id=data['schedule_id'])
        except Schedule.DoesNotExist:
            return Response({'error': 'Schedule does not exist.'}, status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND)

        faculty = resolve_faculty_for_user(request.user)

        if not faculty and not is_leadership_role(request.user):
            return Response(
                {'error': 'Unauthorized: Your account is not linked to a faculty profile.'},
                status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN
            )

        if (
            faculty
            and schedule.faculty_id != faculty.id
            and getattr(schedule.section, 'adviser_id', None) != faculty.id
            and not is_leadership_role(request.user)
        ):
            return Response(
                {'error': f"Unauthorized: You ({faculty.full_name}) are not assigned to teach this class."},
                status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN
            )

        effective_faculty = faculty or schedule.faculty
        today = timezone.localdate()
        scans = data['scans']
        saved_count = 0
        flagged_anomalies = []
        processed_records = []
        model_field_names = [f.name for f in SubjectAttendanceLog._meta.get_fields()]

        for item in scans:
            identifier = item['qr_token'].strip()
            scan_status = item.get('status', 'PRESENT').upper()

            student = Student.objects.filter(
                models.Q(qr_token__iexact=identifier) |
                models.Q(rfid_uid__iexact=identifier) |
                models.Q(lrn__iexact=identifier),
                is_active=True
            ).prefetch_related('enrollments__section').first()

            if not student:
                return Response(
                    {'error': f"Unrecognized identifier '{identifier}'. Student not found in database."},
                    status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND
                )

            student_enr = student.enrollments.select_related('section').filter(status__in=['ENROLLED', 'ACTIVE']).first()
            if not student_enr:
                student_enr = student.enrollments.select_related('section').first()

            enrolled_section = student_enr.section if student_enr else None

            if schedule.section and (not enrolled_section or enrolled_section.id != schedule.section_id):
                current_sec_name = enrolled_section.name if enrolled_section else 'Unassigned'
                target_sec_name = schedule.section.name
                return Response(
                    {'error': f"Access Denied: {format_full_student_name(student)} belongs to '{current_sec_name}', not '{target_sec_name}'."},
                    status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST
                )

            latest_gate_log = StudentGateLog.objects.filter(
                student=student,
                scan_time__date=today
            ).order_by('-scan_time').first()

            has_valid_gate_in = bool(latest_gate_log and latest_gate_log.direction == 'IN')
            attendance_remarks = 'CLASS_SCAN_VERIFIED'
            is_anomaly = False

            if scan_status == 'PRESENT' and not has_valid_gate_in:
                is_anomaly = True
                if latest_gate_log and latest_gate_log.direction == 'OUT':
                    scan_status = 'CUTTING'
                    attendance_remarks = 'FLAGGED: Student tapped OUT at gate prior to class'
                else:
                    scan_status = 'UNVERIFIED'
                    attendance_remarks = 'FLAGGED_PROXY_SCAN: No campus gate entrance recorded today'

                flagged_anomalies.append({
                    'student_id': student.id,
                    'name': format_full_student_name(student),
                    'lrn': student.lrn,
                    'reason': attendance_remarks
                })

            log_defaults = {
                'status': scan_status,
                'scanned_at': timezone.now(),
            }
            if 'faculty' in model_field_names and effective_faculty:
                log_defaults['faculty'] = effective_faculty
            if 'faculty' in model_field_names and effective_faculty:
                log_defaults['faculty'] = effective_faculty

            SubjectAttendanceLog.objects.update_or_create(
                student=student,
                schedule=schedule,
                attendance_date=today,
                defaults=log_defaults
            )

            if schedule.section:
                DailyAttendanceSummary.objects.update_or_create(
                    student=student,
                    attendance_date=today,
                    defaults={
                        'section': schedule.section,
                        'status': scan_status if scan_status != 'UNVERIFIED' else 'ABSENT',
                        'remarks': attendance_remarks
                    }
                )

            photo_abs = safe_photo_url(student.photo, request)
            saved_count += 1
            processed_records.append({
                'student_id': student.id,
                'name': format_full_student_name(student),
                'lrn': student.lrn,
                'rfid_uid': student.rfid_uid or '',
                'photo': photo_abs,
                'photo_url': photo_abs,
                'parent_contact': student.parent_contact or '',
                'guardian_name': student.guardian_name or '',
                'section': schedule.section.name if schedule.section else '',
                'status': scan_status,
                'is_anomaly': is_anomaly,
                'remarks': attendance_remarks,
                'scan_time': timezone.localtime().strftime('%I:%M:%S %p'),
            })

        return Response({
            'success': True,
            'message': f"{saved_count} attendance records processed.",
            'processed_records': processed_records,
            'anomalies': flagged_anomalies
        }, status=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
