class SchoolProfileSerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer):
    left_logo = FlexibleImageField(required=False, allow_null=True)
    right_logo = FlexibleImageField(required=False, allow_null=True)
    school_logo = FlexibleImageField(required=False, allow_null=True)

    principal_photo_url = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    principal_employee_id = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    principal_department = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    principal_email = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    principal_contact_number = serializers.SerializerMethodField()

    class Meta:
        model = SchoolProfile
        fields = '__all__'

    def get_principal_photo_url(self, obj):
        request = self.context.get('request')
        faculty = obj.principal_faculty
        if faculty:
            if faculty.photo:
                return safe_photo_url(faculty.photo, request)
            if hasattr(faculty, 'account') and faculty.account and faculty.account.avatar:
                return safe_photo_url(faculty.account.avatar, request)
            user = User.objects.filter(Q(username__iexact=faculty.employee_id) | Q(email__iexact=faculty.email)).first()
            if user and hasattr(user, 'profile') and user.profile.avatar:
                return safe_photo_url(user.profile.avatar, request)
        return None

    def get_principal_employee_id(self, obj):
        return obj.principal_faculty.employee_id if obj.principal_faculty else ''

    def get_principal_department(self, obj):
        return obj.principal_faculty.department if obj.principal_faculty else 'Administration'

    def get_principal_email(self, obj):
        if obj.principal_faculty:
            return obj.principal_faculty.email or (
                obj.principal_faculty.account.user.email
                if hasattr(obj.principal_faculty, 'account') and obj.principal_faculty.account
                else ''
            )
        return ''

    def get_principal_contact_number(self, obj):
        return obj.principal_faculty.contact_number if obj.principal_faculty else ''


class UserManagementSerializer(serializers.ModelSerializer):
    role = serializers.CharField(required=False, allow_blank=True)
    current_role = serializers.CharField(required=False, allow_blank=True, read_only=True)
    is_teaching = serializers.BooleanField(required=False, default=True)
    can_teach = serializers.BooleanField(required=False, read_only=True)
    is_profile_completed = serializers.BooleanField(required=False, read_only=True)
    faculty_id = serializers.IntegerField(required=False, read_only=True, allow_null=True)

    employee_id = serializers.CharField(required=False, allow_blank=True)
    middle_name = serializers.CharField(required=False, allow_blank=True)
    suffix = serializers.CharField(required=False, allow_blank=True)
    full_name = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    contact_number = serializers.CharField(required=False, allow_blank=True)
    department = serializers.CharField(required=False, allow_blank=True)
    position = serializers.CharField(required=False, allow_blank=True)
    rfid_uid = serializers.CharField(required=False, allow_blank=True, allow_null=True)

    photo = FlexibleImageField(required=False, allow_null=True)
    photo_url = serializers.SerializerMethodField()
    password = serializers.CharField(write_only=True, required=False, allow_blank=True)

    class Meta:
        model = User
        fields = [
            'id', 'username', 'employee_id', 'first_name', 'middle_name', 'last_name',
            'suffix', 'full_name', 'email', 'contact_number', 'department', 'position',
            'rfid_uid', 'role', 'current_role', 'is_teaching', 'can_teach',
            'is_profile_completed', 'faculty_id', 'photo', 'photo_url', 'is_active',
            'is_staff', 'is_superuser', 'password',
        ]

    def _get_profile(self, obj):
        return getattr(obj, 'profile', None) or getattr(obj, 'userprofile', None)

    def get_full_name(self, obj):
        prof = self._get_profile(obj)
        if prof and prof.faculty and prof.faculty.full_name:
            return prof.faculty.full_name
        name_parts = filter(None, [obj.first_name, getattr(obj, 'middle_name', ''), obj.last_name])
        return " ".join(name_parts).strip() or obj.username

    def get_photo_url(self, obj):
        request = self.context.get('request')
        prof = self._get_profile(obj)
        if prof and getattr(prof, 'faculty', None) and prof.faculty.photo:
            return safe_photo_url(prof.faculty.photo, request)
        if prof and getattr(prof, 'avatar', None):
            return safe_photo_url(prof.avatar, request)
        return None

    def validate_employee_id(self, value):
        if not value or not str(value).strip():
            return ''
        clean_id = str(value).strip().upper()
        qs = FacultyProfile.objects.filter(employee_id__iexact=clean_id)
        if self.instance:
            prof = self._get_profile(self.instance)
            if prof and prof.faculty_id:
                qs = qs.exclude(id=prof.faculty_id)
        if qs.exists():
            raise serializers.ValidationError(f"Employee ID '{clean_id}' is already registered.")
        return clean_id

    def validate_rfid_uid(self, value):
        if not value or not str(value).strip():
            return None
        clean_rfid = str(value).strip().upper()
        qs = FacultyProfile.objects.filter(rfid_uid__iexact=clean_rfid)
        if self.instance:
            prof = self._get_profile(self.instance)
            if prof and prof.faculty_id:
                qs = qs.exclude(id=prof.faculty_id)
        if qs.exists():
            raise serializers.ValidationError(f"RFID card UID '{clean_rfid}' is already registered.")
        return clean_rfid

    def to_representation(self, instance):
        ret = super().to_representation(instance)
        prof = self._get_profile(instance)
        faculty = getattr(prof, 'faculty', None) if prof else None

        base_role = str(prof.role).upper() if prof and getattr(prof, 'role', None) else ('ADMIN' if instance.is_superuser else 'FACULTY')
        is_teach = bool(prof.is_teaching) if prof and hasattr(prof, 'is_teaching') else (base_role in ('FACULTY', 'FACULTY_ADMIN'))

        ret['role'] = base_role
        ret['current_role'] = 'FACULTY_ADMIN' if base_role == 'ADMIN' and is_teach else base_role
        ret['is_teaching'] = is_teach
        ret['can_teach'] = is_teach
        ret['is_profile_completed'] = (
            bool(prof.is_profile_completed)
            if prof and hasattr(prof, 'is_profile_completed')
            else bool(instance.first_name and instance.last_name)
        )
        ret['faculty_id'] = getattr(prof, 'faculty_id', None) if prof else None

        ret['employee_id'] = getattr(faculty, 'employee_id', instance.username) if faculty else instance.username
        ret['middle_name'] = getattr(faculty, 'middle_name', '') if faculty else ''
        ret['suffix'] = getattr(faculty, 'suffix', '') if faculty else ''
        ret['contact_number'] = getattr(faculty, 'contact_number', '') if faculty else ''
        ret['department'] = getattr(faculty, 'department', '') if faculty else ''
        ret['position'] = getattr(faculty, 'position', '') if faculty else base_role.replace('_', ' ').title()
        ret['rfid_uid'] = getattr(faculty, 'rfid_uid', '') if faculty else ''

        photo_url = self.get_photo_url(instance)
        ret['photo'] = photo_url
        ret['photo_url'] = photo_url
        return ret

    def _sync_school_principal_settings(self, faculty):
        if not faculty:
            return
        try:
            school = SchoolProfile.objects.first()
            if not school:
                school = SchoolProfile.objects.create(school_id="", school_name="")
            school.principal_faculty = faculty
            school.principal_name = faculty.full_name
            school.principal_title = faculty.position or 'Secondary School Principal IV'
            school.save()
            cache.delete("attendsure_school_settings_fast_payload")
        except Exception:
            pass

    @transaction.atomic
    def create(self, validated_data):
        password = validated_data.pop('password', None)
        raw_role = validated_data.pop('role', None) or self.initial_data.get('role', 'FACULTY')
        is_teaching_param = validated_data.pop('is_teaching', None)
        photo = validated_data.pop('photo', None)

        employee_id_val = validated_data.pop('employee_id', None)
        employee_id = str(employee_id_val or self.initial_data.get('employee_id') or validated_data.get('username') or '').strip().upper()

        middle_name_val = validated_data.pop('middle_name', None)
        middle_name = str(middle_name_val if middle_name_val is not None else self.initial_data.get('middle_name') or '').strip()

        suffix_val = validated_data.pop('suffix', None)
        suffix = str(suffix_val if suffix_val is not None else self.initial_data.get('suffix') or '').strip()

        contact_val = validated_data.pop('contact_number', None)
        contact_number = str(contact_val if contact_val is not None else self.initial_data.get('contact_number') or '').strip()

        dept_val = validated_data.pop('department', None)
        department = str(dept_val if dept_val is not None else self.initial_data.get('department') or 'Junior High School').strip()

        pos_val = validated_data.pop('position', None)
        default_pos = 'Secondary School Principal IV' if str(raw_role).upper() == 'PRINCIPAL' else 'Faculty I'
        position = str(pos_val if pos_val is not None else self.initial_data.get('position') or default_pos).strip()

        raw_rfid = validated_data.pop('rfid_uid', None) or self.initial_data.get('rfid_uid')
        rfid_uid = str(raw_rfid).strip().upper() if raw_rfid and str(raw_rfid).strip() else None

        clean_role_str = str(raw_role).upper()
        if clean_role_str == 'FACULTY_ADMIN':
            final_role = 'ADMIN'
            final_is_teaching = True
        elif clean_role_str == 'FACULTY':
            final_role = 'FACULTY'
            final_is_teaching = bool(is_teaching_param) if is_teaching_param is not None else True
        elif clean_role_str == 'GUARD':
            final_role = 'GUARD'
            final_is_teaching = False
        elif clean_role_str == 'PRINCIPAL':
            final_role = 'PRINCIPAL'
            final_is_teaching = bool(is_teaching_param) if is_teaching_param is not None else True
        else:
            final_role = clean_role_str
            final_is_teaching = bool(is_teaching_param) if is_teaching_param is not None else False

        is_admin = (final_role == 'ADMIN')
        validated_data['is_staff'] = is_admin
        validated_data['is_superuser'] = is_admin

        user = User(**validated_data)
        if password and str(password).strip():
            user.set_password(str(password).strip())
        else:
            user.set_unusable_password()
        user.save()

        photo_bytes = None
        photo_name = getattr(photo, 'name', 'avatar.jpg') if photo else 'avatar.jpg'
        if photo and hasattr(photo, 'read'):
            try:
                photo_bytes = photo.read()
                photo.seek(0)
            except Exception:
                pass

        profile, _ = UserProfile.objects.get_or_create(user=user)
        profile.role = final_role
        profile.is_teaching = final_is_teaching
        profile.is_profile_completed = bool(user.first_name and user.last_name)
        if photo_bytes:
            profile.avatar = ContentFile(photo_bytes, name=photo_name)
        elif photo:
            profile.avatar = photo
        profile.save()

        clean_emp_id = employee_id or user.username.upper()[:50]
        faculty = (
            FacultyProfile.objects.filter(employee_id__iexact=clean_emp_id).first()
            or (FacultyProfile.objects.filter(email__iexact=user.email).first() if user.email else None)
        )

        faculty_photo = ContentFile(photo_bytes, name=photo_name) if photo_bytes else (photo if photo else None)

        if not faculty:
            faculty = FacultyProfile.objects.create(
                employee_id=clean_emp_id,
                first_name=user.first_name or user.username,
                middle_name=middle_name,
                last_name=user.last_name or 'Staff',
                suffix=suffix,
                email=user.email or '',
                contact_number=contact_number,
                department=department,
                position=position,
                rfid_uid=rfid_uid,
                photo=faculty_photo,
                can_teach=final_is_teaching,
                is_active=user.is_active,
                qr_token=secrets.token_urlsafe(32),
            )
        else:
            faculty.first_name = user.first_name or faculty.first_name
            faculty.middle_name = middle_name or faculty.middle_name
            faculty.last_name = user.last_name or faculty.last_name
            faculty.suffix = suffix or faculty.suffix
            faculty.email = user.email or faculty.email
            faculty.contact_number = contact_number or faculty.contact_number
            faculty.department = department or faculty.department
            faculty.position = position or faculty.position
            if rfid_uid is not None:
                faculty.rfid_uid = rfid_uid
            if faculty_photo:
                faculty.photo = faculty_photo
            faculty.can_teach = final_is_teaching
            faculty.is_active = user.is_active
            faculty.save()

        profile.faculty = faculty
        profile.save(update_fields=['faculty'])

        if final_role == 'PRINCIPAL':
            self._sync_school_principal_settings(faculty)

        return user

    @transaction.atomic
    def update(self, instance, validated_data):
        request = self.context.get('request')
        is_request_admin = False
        if request and request.user and request.user.is_authenticated:
            is_request_admin = request.user.is_superuser or get_user_role(request.user) == 'ADMIN'

        password = validated_data.pop('password', None)
        raw_role = validated_data.pop('role', None) or self.initial_data.get('role', None)
        is_teaching_param = validated_data.pop('is_teaching', None)
        photo = validated_data.pop('photo', None)

        # Cybersecurity: Non-admin users cannot alter administrative fields
        if not is_request_admin:
            raw_role = None
            is_teaching_param = None
            validated_data.pop('is_staff', None)
            validated_data.pop('is_superuser', None)
            validated_data.pop('is_active', None)

        employee_id_val = validated_data.pop('employee_id', None)
        employee_id = employee_id_val if employee_id_val is not None else self.initial_data.get('employee_id')

        middle_name_val = validated_data.pop('middle_name', None)
        middle_name = middle_name_val if middle_name_val is not None else self.initial_data.get('middle_name')

        suffix_val = validated_data.pop('suffix', None)
        suffix = suffix_val if suffix_val is not None else self.initial_data.get('suffix')

        contact_val = validated_data.pop('contact_number', None)
        contact_number = contact_val if contact_val is not None else self.initial_data.get('contact_number')

        dept_val = validated_data.pop('department', None)
        department = dept_val if dept_val is not None else self.initial_data.get('department')

        pos_val = validated_data.pop('position', None)
        position = pos_val if pos_val is not None else self.initial_data.get('position')

        raw_rfid = validated_data.pop('rfid_uid', None) or self.initial_data.get('rfid_uid')
        rfid_uid = str(raw_rfid).strip().upper() if raw_rfid and str(raw_rfid).strip() else None

        if password and str(password).strip():
            instance.set_password(str(password).strip())

        if raw_role and is_request_admin:
            clean_role_str = str(raw_role).upper()
            if clean_role_str == 'FACULTY_ADMIN':
                final_role = 'ADMIN'
                final_is_teaching = True
            elif clean_role_str == 'FACULTY':
                final_role = 'FACULTY'
                final_is_teaching = bool(is_teaching_param) if is_teaching_param is not None else True
            elif clean_role_str == 'GUARD':
                final_role = 'GUARD'
                final_is_teaching = False
            elif clean_role_str == 'PRINCIPAL':
                final_role = 'PRINCIPAL'
                final_is_teaching = bool(is_teaching_param) if is_teaching_param is not None else True
            else:
                final_role = clean_role_str
                final_is_teaching = bool(is_teaching_param) if is_teaching_param is not None else False

            is_admin = (final_role == 'ADMIN')
            instance.is_staff = is_admin
            instance.is_superuser = is_admin
        else:
            final_role = None
            final_is_teaching = is_teaching_param

        for attr, value in validated_data.items():
            setattr(instance, attr, value)
        instance.save()

        photo_bytes = None
        photo_name = getattr(photo, 'name', 'avatar.jpg') if photo else 'avatar.jpg'
        if photo and hasattr(photo, 'read'):
            try:
                photo_bytes = photo.read()
                photo.seek(0)
            except Exception:
                pass

        profile, _ = UserProfile.objects.get_or_create(user=instance)
        if final_role:
            profile.role = final_role
        if final_is_teaching is not None and is_request_admin:
            profile.is_teaching = bool(final_is_teaching)
        profile.is_profile_completed = bool(instance.first_name and instance.last_name)
        if photo_bytes:
            profile.avatar = ContentFile(photo_bytes, name=photo_name)
        elif photo is not None:
            profile.avatar = photo
        profile.save()

        faculty = profile.faculty
        if not faculty:
            clean_emp_id = (employee_id or instance.username).strip().upper()[:50]
            faculty = FacultyProfile.objects.filter(
                Q(employee_id__iexact=clean_emp_id) | Q(email__iexact=instance.email)
            ).first()
            if faculty:
                profile.faculty = faculty
                profile.save(update_fields=['faculty'])

        faculty_photo = ContentFile(photo_bytes, name=photo_name) if photo_bytes else photo

        if faculty:
            if is_request_admin and employee_id is not None and str(employee_id).strip():
                faculty.employee_id = str(employee_id).strip().upper()[:50]
            faculty.first_name = instance.first_name or faculty.first_name
            if middle_name is not None:
                faculty.middle_name = str(middle_name).strip()
            faculty.last_name = instance.last_name or faculty.last_name
            if suffix is not None:
                faculty.suffix = str(suffix).strip()
            faculty.email = instance.email or faculty.email
            if contact_number is not None:
                faculty.contact_number = str(contact_number).strip()
            if is_request_admin and department is not None:
                faculty.department = str(department).strip()
            if is_request_admin and position is not None:
                faculty.position = str(position).strip()
            if is_request_admin and raw_rfid is not None:
                faculty.rfid_uid = rfid_uid
            if faculty_photo is not None:
                faculty.photo = faculty_photo
            elif profile.avatar and not faculty.photo:
                faculty.photo = profile.avatar
            if final_is_teaching is not None and is_request_admin:
                faculty.can_teach = bool(final_is_teaching)
            faculty.is_active = instance.is_active
            faculty.save()
        else:
            clean_emp_id = (employee_id or instance.username).strip().upper()[:50]
            new_faculty = FacultyProfile.objects.create(
                employee_id=clean_emp_id,
                first_name=instance.first_name or instance.username,
                middle_name=str(middle_name or '').strip(),
                last_name=instance.last_name or 'Staff',
                suffix=str(suffix or '').strip(),
                email=instance.email or '',
                contact_number=str(contact_number or '').strip(),
                department=str(department or 'Junior High School').strip(),
                position=str(position or 'Faculty I').strip(),
                rfid_uid=rfid_uid if is_request_admin else None,
                photo=faculty_photo if faculty_photo else profile.avatar,
                can_teach=bool(final_is_teaching) if (final_is_teaching is not None and is_request_admin) else False,
                is_active=instance.is_active,
                qr_token=secrets.token_urlsafe(32),
            )
            profile.faculty = new_faculty
            profile.save(update_fields=['faculty'])
            faculty = new_faculty

        if profile.role == 'PRINCIPAL':
            self._sync_school_principal_settings(faculty)

        return instance

"""
AttendSure V3 - Hardware Wake-Up Push Service
File: backend/apps/api/services/push_service.py

Cybersecurity & Performance:
- Uses TLS-encrypted HTTPS requests to the push gateway.
- Timeout guard (3.0s) prevents slow push calls from delaying gate scans.
- High-priority data-only message forces mobile OS to wake up the app.
"""

import json
import urllib.request
import urllib.error
import logging

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

EXPO_PUSH_URL = "https://exp.host/--/api/v2/push/send"


def send_silent_wake_up_push(push_token: str, action: str = "START_TRACKING_IN") -> bool:
    """
    Sends a silent high-priority wake-up push message to the faculty phone.
    action: "START_TRACKING_IN" (turn on GPS) or "STOP_TRACKING_OUT" (turn off GPS)
    """
    if not push_token or not push_token.startswith("ExponentPushToken"):
        return False

    payload = {
        "to": push_token,
        "priority": "high",  # Wakes Android and iOS from standby
        "_contentAvailable": True,  # Required for iOS background execution
        "data": {
            "action": action,
        },
    }

    try:
        req_data = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            EXPO_PUSH_URL,
            data=req_data,
            headers={
                "Content-Type": "application/json",
                "Accept": "application/json",
                "Accept-Encoding": "gzip, deflate",
            },
            method="POST",
        )

        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=3.0) as response:
            result = json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))
            logger.info(f"[WakeUpPush] Signal '{action}' sent to device: {result}")
            return True

    except Exception as exc:
        logger.warning(f"[WakeUpPush] Could not send push wake-up: {exc}")
        return False

"""
AttendSure V3 - System & User Activity Audit Log Engine
File: backend/apps/api/views/activity.py
"""

import json
import logging
from datetime import datetime

from django.utils import timezone
from django.db.models import Q
from django.db.models.fields.json import JSONField

from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework import status, permissions, viewsets
from rest_framework.throttling import UserRateThrottle

from apps.academics.models import AuditLog

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# --- CYBERSECURITY & COMPATIBILITY HOTFIX ---
# Prevent TypeError when database drivers return pre-parsed JSON lists or dictionaries
_original_from_db_value = getattr(JSONField, 'from_db_value', None)


def _safe_from_db_value(self, value, expression, connection):
    if value is None or isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, (str, bytes, bytearray)):
        try:
            return json.loads(value, cls=self.decoder)
        except Exception:
            return value
    return value


JSONField.from_db_value = _safe_from_db_value
# --------------------------------------------


class UserActivityLogsAPIView(APIView):
    """
    Central Activity Logs for Settings Screen:
    - Queries real database AuditLog records with zero mock data.
    - Faster data fetching: uses select_related to prevent N+1 queries.
    - Cybersecurity: Admins see system-wide logs; regular users only see their own actions.
    """
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]
    throttle_classes = [UserRateThrottle]

    def get(self, request):
        user = request.user
        search_query = request.query_params.get('search', '').strip()
        action_filter = request.query_params.get('action', 'ALL').strip().upper()
        date_param = request.query_params.get('date', '').strip()

        # 1. Determine administrative authority
        is_admin = bool(user.is_superuser or user.is_staff)
        if hasattr(user, 'profile') and getattr(user.profile, 'role', None):
            if str(user.profile.role).upper() in ['ADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL', 'SUPERUSER']:
                is_admin = True

        # 2. Faster Data Fetching: single database trip via select_related
        logs = AuditLog.objects.select_related('performed_by').all().order_by('-created_at')

        # 3. Cybersecurity Data Isolation: non-admins strictly isolated to their own actions
        if not is_admin:
            logs = logs.filter(performed_by=user)

        # 4. Action Type Filter
        if action_filter and action_filter != 'ALL':
            logs = logs.filter(action__iexact=action_filter)

        # 5. Calendar Date Filter
        if date_param:
            try:
                target_date = datetime.strptime(date_param, '%Y-%m-%d').date()
                logs = logs.filter(created_at__date=target_date)
            except ValueError:
                pass

        # 6. Fast Search across user, action, table, client IP, and record ID
        if search_query:
            query_filter = (
                Q(action__icontains=search_query)
                | Q(table_name__icontains=search_query)
                | Q(client_ip__icontains=search_query)
                | Q(record_id__icontains=search_query)
                | Q(performed_by__username__icontains=search_query)
                | Q(performed_by__first_name__icontains=search_query)
                | Q(performed_by__last_name__icontains=search_query)
            )
            logs = logs.filter(query_filter)

        # 7. Safe Fetch with Multi-Layered Driver Protection
        try:
            logs_subset = list(logs[:250])
        except TypeError:
            # Fallback if driver bypasses the class patch
            try:
                logs_subset = list(logs.defer('changed_fields')[:250])
            except Exception:
                logs_subset = list(
                    logs.only(
                        'id', 'action', 'table_name', 'record_id', 'created_at', 'client_ip', 'performed_by'
                    )[:250]
                )
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"[UserActivityLogsAPIView] Query error: {e}", exc_info=True)
            logs_subset = []

        results = []
        for item in logs_subset:
            # Resolve user display name safely without throwing AttributeError
            if item.performed_by:
                full = getattr(item.performed_by, 'get_full_name', lambda: '')()
                user_label = full.strip() if full else item.performed_by.username
            else:
                user_label = "System / Terminal"

            # Format details safely from strings, lists, or dictionaries
            details_parts = []
            if item.table_name:
                details_parts.append(f"Target: {item.table_name}")
            if item.record_id:
                details_parts.append(f"#{item.record_id}")
            if hasattr(item, 'changed_fields') and item.changed_fields:
                if isinstance(item.changed_fields, list):
                    clean_fields = [str(f) for f in item.changed_fields]
                    details_parts.append(f"Fields: {', '.join(clean_fields)}")
                elif isinstance(item.changed_fields, dict):
                    details_parts.append(f"Fields: {', '.join(item.changed_fields.keys())}")
                else:
                    details_parts.append(f"Fields: {str(item.changed_fields)[:80]}")

            detail_text = " • ".join(details_parts) if details_parts else "Audit record logged"

            # Convert to local time in standard 12-hour AM/PM format
            dt = item.created_at
            local_dt = timezone.localtime(dt) if timezone.is_aware(dt) else dt

            results.append({
                'id': item.id,
                'timestamp': local_dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %I:%M:%S %p'),
                'time_only': local_dt.strftime('%I:%M:%S %p'),
                'date_only': local_dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),
                'user': user_label,
                'action': (item.action or 'AUDIT_RECORD').upper(),
                'module': (item.table_name or 'ACADEMICS').upper(),
                'details': detail_text,
                'ip_address': item.client_ip or '127.0.0.1',
                'status': 'SUCCESS',
            })

        return Response({
            'success': True,
            'is_admin': is_admin,
            'total_activities': len(results),
            'total': len(results),
            'records': results,
            'results': results,
        }, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)

import base64

class AuthLoginRateThrottle(AnonRateThrottle):
    rate = '10/minute'


class ValidationRateThrottle(AnonRateThrottle):
    rate = '60/minute'


def _process_uploaded_photo(raw_photo):
    if not raw_photo:
        return None

    if hasattr(raw_photo, 'read'):
        try:
            raw_photo.seek(0)
            photo_bytes = raw_photo.read()
            name = getattr(raw_photo, 'name', 'avatar.jpg')
            return ContentFile(photo_bytes, name=name)
        except Exception:
            return None

    if isinstance(raw_photo, str):
        clean = raw_photo.strip()
        if clean.startswith('data:image') and ';base64,' in clean:
            try:
                header, img_str = clean.split(';base64,', 1)
                raw_ext = header.split('/')[-1].split(';')[0].lower()
                ext = 'jpg' if raw_ext in ('jpeg', 'pjpeg') else raw_ext
                if ext not in {'png', 'jpg', 'jpeg', 'webp'}:
                    ext = 'jpg'

                decoded_bytes = base64.b64decode(img_str, validate=True)
                if len(decoded_bytes) <= 5 * 1024 * 1024:
                    filename = f"avatar_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:10]}.{ext}"
                    return ContentFile(decoded_bytes, name=filename)
            except Exception:
                return None

    return None


def build_authenticated_user_payload(user, request=None):
    faculty = resolve_faculty_for_user(user)
    school = SchoolProfile.objects.first()
    profile = getattr(user, 'profile', None)
    assigned_role = get_user_role(user)

    emp_id = getattr(faculty, 'employee_id', user.username) if faculty else user.username
    first_name = (getattr(faculty, 'first_name', '') or user.first_name or '').strip()
    middle_name = (getattr(faculty, 'middle_name', '') or '').strip()
    last_name = (getattr(faculty, 'last_name', '') or user.last_name or '').strip()
    full_name = (
        getattr(faculty, 'full_name', '')
        if faculty
        else " ".join(filter(None, [first_name, middle_name, last_name])).strip() or user.username
    )

    photo_url = None
    if faculty and faculty.photo:
        photo_url = safe_photo_url(faculty.photo, request)
    elif profile and profile.avatar:
        photo_url = safe_photo_url(profile.avatar, request)

    teaching_class_count = Schedule.objects.filter(faculty=faculty).count() if faculty else 0
    can_teach = bool(getattr(faculty, 'can_teach', True)) and bool(getattr(profile, 'is_teaching', True))

    return {
        'id': user.id,
        'username': user.username,
        'first_name': first_name,
        'middle_name': middle_name,
        'last_name': last_name,
        'full_name': full_name,
        'faculty_name': full_name,
        'faculty_id': emp_id,
        'faculty_pk': getattr(faculty, 'id', None),
        'email': getattr(faculty, 'email', '') or user.email or '',
        'contact_number': getattr(faculty, 'contact_number', '') if faculty else '',
        'position': getattr(faculty, 'position', '') if faculty else '',
        'department': getattr(faculty, 'department', '') if faculty else '',
        'rfid_uid': getattr(faculty, 'rfid_uid', '') if faculty else '',
        'photo': photo_url,
        'photo_url': photo_url,
        'school_name': getattr(school, 'school_name', '') if school else '',
        'role': assigned_role,
        'system_role': assigned_role,
        'is_profile_completed': bool(profile and getattr(profile, 'is_profile_completed', True)),
        'can_teach': can_teach,
        'is_teaching': can_teach or (teaching_class_count > 0) or is_regular_faculty(assigned_role),
        'assigned_class_count': teaching_class_count,
        'is_superuser': user.is_superuser,
    }


class DatabaseLoginView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [AllowAny]
    throttle_classes = [AuthLoginRateThrottle]

    def post(self, request):
        username = str(request.data.get('username', '')).strip()
        password = str(request.data.get('password', '')).strip()

        if not username or not password:
            return Response({'error': 'Username and password are required.'}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)

        existing_user = User.objects.filter(username__iexact=username).first()
        profile = getattr(existing_user, 'profile', None) if existing_user else None

        if profile and hasattr(profile, 'is_locked') and profile.is_locked():
            return Response(
                {'error': 'Account locked due to excessive failed attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.'},
                status=status.HTTP_429_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS,
            )

        user = authenticate(request=request, username=username, password=password)
        if user is None:
            if profile and hasattr(profile, 'record_failed_attempt'):
                profile.record_failed_attempt()
            return Response({'error': 'Invalid credentials.'}, status=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED)

        if not user.is_active:
            return Response({'error': 'Account is inactive. Contact school admin.'}, status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN)

        if profile and hasattr(profile, 'reset_failed_attempts'):
            profile.reset_failed_attempts()

        token, _ = Token.objects.get_or_create(user=user)
        return Response({'token': token.key, 'user': build_authenticated_user_payload(user, request)}, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)


LoginAPIView = DatabaseLoginView


class CurrentUserView(APIView):
    """
    Complete Profile CRUD for Authenticated Users:
    - GET: Read personal profile details.
    - POST: Complete/create initial profile information.
    - PUT / PATCH: Update name, email, phone, photo, or password.
    - DELETE: Delete or deactivate own account.
    """
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request):
        return Response(build_authenticated_user_payload(request.user, request), status=status.HTTP_200_OK)

    def post(self, request):
        return self.put(request)

    @transaction.atomic
    def put(self, request):
        user = request.user
        data = request.data
        files = request.FILES

        first_name = data.get('first_name') if 'first_name' in data else data.get('firstName')
        last_name = data.get('last_name') if 'last_name' in data else data.get('lastName')
        middle_name = data.get('middle_name') if 'middle_name' in data else data.get('middleName')
        suffix = data.get('suffix')
        contact_number = data.get('contact_number') or data.get('contactNumber') or data.get('phone')
        raw_photo = files.get('photo') or files.get('avatar') or data.get('photo') or data.get('avatar')

        user_updates = []
        if first_name is not None:
            user.first_name = str(first_name).strip()
            user_updates.append('first_name')

        if last_name is not None:
            user.last_name = str(last_name).strip()
            user_updates.append('last_name')

        if 'email' in data:
            clean_email = str(data.get('email', '')).strip()
            if clean_email:
                try:
                    validate_email(clean_email)
                except DjangoValidationError:
                    return Response({'error': 'Invalid email address format.'}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)
                if User.objects.filter(email__iexact=clean_email).exclude(id=user.id).exists():
                    return Response({'error': 'Email is already used by another account.'}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)
            user.email = clean_email
            user_updates.append('email')

        new_password = data.get('password')
        if new_password:
            clean_pw = str(new_password).strip()
            if len(clean_pw) < 8:
                return Response({'error': 'Password must be at least 8 characters long.'}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)
            try:
                validate_password(clean_pw, user=user)
            except DjangoValidationError as exc:
                return Response({'error': list(exc.messages)}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)
            user.set_password(clean_pw)
            user_updates.append('password')

        if user_updates:
            user.save()

        photo_file = _process_uploaded_photo(raw_photo)

        profile, _ = UserProfile.objects.get_or_create(user=user)
        profile.is_profile_completed = bool(user.first_name and user.last_name)
        if photo_file:
            profile.avatar = photo_file
            profile.save(update_fields=['avatar', 'is_profile_completed'])
        else:
            profile.save(update_fields=['is_profile_completed'])

        faculty = resolve_faculty_for_user(user)
        if not faculty:
            clean_emp_id = (user.username or 'EMP').strip().upper()[:50]
            faculty = FacultyProfile.objects.filter(employee_id__iexact=clean_emp_id).first()
            if not faculty:
                faculty = FacultyProfile.objects.create(
                    employee_id=clean_emp_id,
                    first_name=user.first_name or user.username,
                    middle_name=str(middle_name or '').strip(),
                    last_name=user.last_name or 'Staff',
                    suffix=str(suffix or '').strip(),
                    email=user.email or '',
                    contact_number=str(contact_number or '').strip(),
                    photo=photo_file,
                    is_active=True,
                )
            profile.faculty = faculty
            profile.save(update_fields=['faculty'])
        else:
            fac_updates = []
            if first_name is not None:
                faculty.first_name = user.first_name
                fac_updates.append('first_name')
            if last_name is not None:
                faculty.last_name = user.last_name
                fac_updates.append('last_name')
            if middle_name is not None:
                faculty.middle_name = str(middle_name).strip()
                fac_updates.append('middle_name')
            if suffix is not None:
                faculty.suffix = str(suffix).strip()
                fac_updates.append('suffix')
            if 'email' in data:
                faculty.email = user.email
                fac_updates.append('email')
            if contact_number is not None:
                faculty.contact_number = str(contact_number).strip()
                fac_updates.append('contact_number')
            if photo_file:
                faculty.photo = photo_file
                fac_updates.append('photo')

            if fac_updates:
                faculty.save(update_fields=fac_updates)

        return Response(build_authenticated_user_payload(user, request), status=status.HTTP_200_OK)

    def patch(self, request):
        return self.put(request)

    @transaction.atomic
    def delete(self, request):
        """Allows users to delete or close their own profile."""
        user = request.user
        if user.is_superuser and User.objects.filter(is_superuser=True, is_active=True).count() <= 1:
            return Response({'error': 'Cannot delete the only system administrator account.'}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)

        Token.objects.filter(user=user).delete()
        user.delete()
        return Response({'success': True, 'message': 'Your account has been deleted.'}, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)

class LiveFieldValidationAPIView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]
    throttle_classes = [ValidationRateThrottle]

    def _validate(self, field, val, exclude_id):
        val = str(val or '').strip()
        field = str(field or '').strip().lower()
        is_taken = False
        message = ''

        if field == 'username' and val:
            qs = User.objects.filter(username__iexact=val)
            if exclude_id and str(exclude_id).isdigit():
                qs = qs.exclude(id=int(exclude_id))
            is_taken = qs.exists()
            if is_taken:
                message = f"Username '{val}' is already taken."
        elif field == 'email' and val:
            try:
                validate_email(val)
                qs = User.objects.filter(email__iexact=val)
                if exclude_id and str(exclude_id).isdigit():
                    qs = qs.exclude(id=int(exclude_id))
                is_taken = qs.exists()
                if is_taken:
                    message = f"Email '{val}' is already in use."
            except DjangoValidationError:
                return {'valid': False, 'is_taken': False, 'message': 'Invalid email format.'}

        return {'valid': not is_taken, 'is_taken': is_taken, 'message': message}

    def get(self, request):
        return Response(self._validate(request.query_params.get('field'), request.query_params.get('value'), request.query_params.get('exclude_id')), status=status.HTTP_200_OK)

    def post(self, request):
        data = request.data or request.query_params
        return Response(self._validate(data.get('field'), data.get('value'), data.get('exclude_id')), status=status.HTTP_200_OK)


class RegisterPushTokenAPIView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request):
        token = str(request.data.get('push_token', '')).strip()
        if not token:

        profile.push_token = token
        profile.save(update_fields=['push_token'])

        return Response({'success': True, 'message': 'Push token registered successfully.'}, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)

# ============================================================================
# HELPER FUNCTIONS

def sanitize_qr_token(raw_token: str) -> str:
    """Extracts clean identifier from plain text, JSON, or tagged barcode formats."""
    clean = str(raw_token or '').strip().replace('\r', '').replace('\n', '')
    if clean.startswith('{') and clean.endswith('}'):
        try:
            parsed = json.loads(clean)
            return str(parsed.get('lrn') or parsed.get('student_lrn') or parsed.get('qr_token') or parsed.get('id') or clean).strip()
        except Exception:
            pass
    if ':' in clean:
        return clean.split(':')[-1].strip()
    return clean


def get_device_model():
    """Finds the DeviceApproval model across registered apps safely."""
    from django.apps import apps
    for app in ['core', 'academics', 'common', 'api']:
        try:
            m = apps.get_model(app, 'DeviceApproval')
            if m:
                return m
        except LookupError:
            continue
    return None


def format_section_label(grade_name: str, section_name: str) -> str:
    """Combines Grade Level and Section cleanly."""
    if grade_name and section_name:
        return f"{grade_name} - {section_name}" if not section_name.startswith(grade_name) else section_name
    return section_name or grade_name or "Unassigned"


def resolve_student_photo_url(student, request):
    """
    Safely resolves profile photo URL across ImageField, CharField photo_path, 
    or photo_thumbnail database fields.
    """
    photo_field = (
        getattr(student, 'photo', None)
        or getattr(student, 'photo_path', None)
        or getattr(student, 'photo_thumbnail', None)
    )
    if not photo_field:
        return None

    resolved = safe_photo_url(photo_field, request)
    if resolved:
        return resolved

    if hasattr(photo_field, 'url'):
        try:
            return photo_field.url
        except Exception:
            pass

    photo_str = str(photo_field).strip()
    if photo_str and photo_str != 'None':
        if photo_str.startswith(('http://', 'https://', '/')):
            return photo_str
        return f"/media/{photo_str}"

    return None

# 1. HARDWARE OTG / USB / CAMERA SINGLE STUDENT SCANNER
# ============================================================================

class ClassroomStudentScanAPIView(APIView):
    """
    Classroom Attendance & Student Verification Endpoint.
    Used by:
    - Web App: Laptops & PCs with USB / Wireless Barcode Scanners or Webcams.
    - Mobile App: Phones with USB-C OTG Scanner Guns or built-in Cameras.
    Validates faculty role (Class Adviser vs Subject Faculty), gate status, and registered devices.
    """
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    @transaction.atomic
    def post(self, request):
        user = request.user
        role = get_user_role(user)
        now = timezone.now()
        today = timezone.localdate()

        # 1. Device Security Verification
        device_uuid = request.headers.get('X-Device-UUID') or request.data.get('device_uuid')
        DeviceModel = get_device_model()
        if DeviceModel and device_uuid:
            device_entry = DeviceModel.objects.filter(
                device_uuid=device_uuid,
                is_active=True
            ).first()

            if device_entry and getattr(device_entry, 'approval_status', 'APPROVED') == 'REJECTED':
                return Response({
                    'error': 'This scanning device has been blocked. Contact school administration.'
                }, status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN)

        # 2. Resolve Faculty Profile safely using account reference
        faculty = resolve_faculty_for_user(user)
        if not faculty:
            faculty = FacultyProfile.objects.filter(account=user).first()

        is_admin = is_leadership_role(user) or user.is_superuser or role in ('ADMIN', 'SUPERADMIN', 'PRINCIPAL')

        if not faculty and not is_admin:
            return Response({
                'error': 'Only verified faculty, advisers, and administrators can record attendance.'
            }, status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN)

        # 3. Clean Scanned Token (Supports Barcode guns, RFID cards, and QR tokens)
        raw_code = str(
            request.data.get('code')
            or request.data.get('raw_identifier')
            or request.data.get('qr_token')
            or ''
        ).strip()

        cleaned_token = sanitize_qr_token(raw_code)
        if not cleaned_token:
            return Response({'error': 'No barcode or QR code received.'}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)

        # 4. Fast Single-Trip Database Query to Match Student
        student = Student.objects.filter(
            Q(lrn__iexact=cleaned_token) |
            Q(qr_token=cleaned_token) |
            Q(rfid_uid__iexact=cleaned_token),
            is_active=True
        ).first()

        if not student:
            return Response({
                'error': f'Unregistered student card or barcode ({cleaned_token}).'
            }, status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND)

        # 5. Resolve Student Active Section
        enrollment = Enrollment.objects.filter(
            student=student,
            status='ENROLLED'
        ).select_related('section', 'section__grade_level').first()

        if not enrollment or not enrollment.section:
            return Response({
                'error': f'Student {student.full_name} is not enrolled in an active section.'
            }, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)

        student_section = enrollment.section
        grade_name = student_section.grade_level.name if student_section.grade_level else ''
        section_display = format_section_label(grade_name, student_section.name)

        # 6. Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Verify Faculty Authorization
        is_adviser = bool(faculty and student_section.adviser_id == faculty.id)

        active_schedule = None
        if faculty:
            active_schedule = Schedule.objects.filter(
                faculty=faculty,
                section=student_section
            ).select_related('subject').first()

        is_subject_faculty = bool(active_schedule)

        if not (is_adviser or is_subject_faculty or is_admin):
            return Response({
                'error': (
                    f'Access Denied: You are neither the Class Adviser nor a Subject Faculty '
                    f'for {section_display}.'
                )
            }, status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN)

        role_label = "Class Adviser" if is_adviser else ("Subject Faculty" if is_subject_faculty else "Administrator")

        # 7. Resolve Target Schedule
        target_schedule = active_schedule if active_schedule else Schedule.objects.filter(section=student_section).first()

        # 8. Check Campus Gate Status
        today_start = timezone.make_aware(datetime.combine(today, datetime.min.time()))
        today_end = timezone.make_aware(datetime.combine(today, datetime.max.time()))

        latest_gate = StudentGateLog.objects.filter(
            student=student,
            scan_time__gte=today_start,
            scan_time__lte=today_end
        ).order_by('-scan_time').first()

        gate_remarks = "Gate entrance verified."
        if not latest_gate:
            gate_remarks = "FLAGGED: No gate entry scan recorded today."
        elif latest_gate.direction == 'OUT':
            gate_remarks = "FLAGGED: Student was previously recorded leaving campus."

        photo_url = resolve_student_photo_url(student, request)

        # 9. Duplicate Prevention: Check if already recorded for this schedule today
        existing_log_query = {
            'student': student,
            'attendance_date': today,
        }
        if target_schedule:
            existing_log_query['schedule'] = target_schedule

        existing_log = SubjectAttendanceLog.objects.filter(**existing_log_query).first()

        if existing_log:
            scanned_time = (
                getattr(existing_log, 'scanned_at', None)
                or getattr(existing_log, 'scan_time', None)
                or now
            )
            timestamp_str = timezone.localtime(scanned_time).strftime('%I:%M:%S %p')

            return Response({
                'success': True,
                'is_duplicate': True,
                'message': 'Card already tapped. Attendance already recorded for this class today.',
                'authorization_role': role_label,
                'student_id': student.id,
                'student_name': format_full_student_name(student),
                'lrn': student.lrn,
                'section': section_display,
                'status': getattr(existing_log, 'status', 'PRESENT'),
                'scanned_at': timestamp_str,
                'gate_status_note': gate_remarks,
                'photo_url': photo_url,
                'photo': photo_url,
            }, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)

        # 10. Record Verified Attendance using Safe Upsert
        log_fields = {f.name for f in SubjectAttendanceLog._meta.fields}
        log_defaults = {
            'status': 'PRESENT',
        }
        if 'faculty' in log_fields:
            log_defaults['faculty'] = target_schedule.faculty if (target_schedule and target_schedule.faculty) else faculty
        if 'scanned_at' in log_fields:
            log_defaults['scanned_at'] = now
        if 'scan_time' in log_fields:
            log_defaults['scan_time'] = now

        log_filter_kwargs = {
            'student': student,
            'attendance_date': today,
        }
        if 'schedule' in log_fields and target_schedule:
            log_filter_kwargs['schedule'] = target_schedule

        try:
            log, created = SubjectAttendanceLog.objects.update_or_create(
                **log_filter_kwargs,
                defaults=log_defaults
            )
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"[ClassroomStudentScanAPIView] update_or_create caught conflict: {e}")
            log = SubjectAttendanceLog.objects.filter(**log_filter_kwargs).first()
            created = False

        # 11. Update Daily Attendance Summary for Dashboards
        summary_fields = {f.name for f in DailyAttendanceSummary._meta.fields}
        summary_defaults = {
            'section': student_section,
            'status': 'PRESENT',
        }
        if 'remarks' in summary_fields:
            summary_defaults['remarks'] = gate_remarks[:255]

        DailyAttendanceSummary.objects.update_or_create(
            student=student,
            attendance_date=today,
            defaults=summary_defaults
        )

        timestamp_display = timezone.localtime(now).strftime('%I:%M:%S %p')

        return Response({
            'success': True,
            'is_duplicate': not created,
            'message': f'Attendance verified by {role_label}.' if created else 'Card already tapped today.',
            'authorization_role': role_label,
            'student_id': student.id,
            'student_name': format_full_student_name(student),
            'lrn': student.lrn,
            'section': section_display,
            'status': 'PRESENT',
            'scanned_at': timestamp_display,
            'gate_status_note': gate_remarks,
            'photo_url': photo_url,
            'photo': photo_url,
        }, status=status.HTTP_201_CREATED if created else status.HTTP_200_OK)


ClassroomScanAPIView = ClassroomStudentScanAPIView

# 2. HARDWARE DEVICE REGISTRATION FOR GEOFENCING & SCANNER APPROVAL
# ============================================================================

class UserDeviceRegisterAPIView(APIView):
    """
    Registers staff and faculty mobile phones, laptops, and PCs for geofencing compliance.
    """
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request):
        user = request.user
        device_uuid = str(request.data.get('device_uuid', '')).strip()
        device_name = str(request.data.get('device_name', 'Station Device')).strip()
        platform = str(request.data.get('platform', 'WEB')).upper()

        if not device_uuid:
            return Response({'error': 'Device unique identifier required.'}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)

        DeviceModel = get_device_model()
        if not DeviceModel:
            return Response({'success': True, 'message': 'Device registered for campus presence.'})

        model_fields = {f.name for f in DeviceModel._meta.fields}
        device_defaults = {
            'device_name': device_name,
            'platform': platform,
            'approval_status': 'APPROVED' if (user.is_staff or user.is_superuser) else 'PENDING',
            'is_active': True,
        }
        if 'account' in model_fields:
            device_defaults['account'] = user
        elif 'user' in model_fields:
            device_defaults['user'] = user

        device, created = DeviceModel.objects.get_or_create(
            device_uuid=device_uuid,
            defaults=device_defaults
        )

        return Response({
            'success': True,
            'device_uuid': device.device_uuid,
            'status': getattr(device, 'approval_status', 'APPROVED'),
            'message': 'Hardware device registered for attendance scanning.'
        }, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)


DeviceRegisterAPIView = UserDeviceRegisterAPIView

class ClassListAPIView(APIView):
    """
    Returns teaching classes for the authenticated faculty with enrolled student lists
    and today's real attendance status pre-calculated in fast batch queries.
    """
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request):
        user = request.user
        faculty = resolve_faculty_for_user(user)
        if not faculty:
            faculty = FacultyProfile.objects.filter(account=user).first()

        is_admin = is_leadership_role(user) or user.is_superuser
        view_mode = str(request.query_params.get('mode', '')).lower()
        today = timezone.localdate()

        if is_admin and view_mode == 'all':
            scheds = Schedule.objects.all()
        elif faculty:
            scheds = Schedule.objects.filter(Q(faculty=faculty) | Q(section__adviser=faculty)).distinct()
        elif is_admin:
            scheds = Schedule.objects.all()
        else:
            scheds = Schedule.objects.none()

        scheds = scheds.select_related('section', 'section__grade_level', 'subject', 'faculty').order_by('start_time')
        scheds_list = list(scheds)
        section_ids = [s.section_id for s in scheds_list if s.section_id]

        if faculty:
            extra_advisory = Section.objects.filter(adviser=faculty).exclude(id__in=section_ids).select_related('grade_level')
            for sec in extra_advisory:
                section_ids.append(sec.id)
        else:
            extra_advisory = []

        enrollments_qs = (
            Enrollment.objects.filter(section_id__in=section_ids, status='ENROLLED', student__is_active=True)
            .select_related('student')
            .order_by('student__last_name', 'student__first_name')
        )

        students_by_section = {}
        all_student_ids = []
        for enr in enrollments_qs:
            if enr.student:
                students_by_section.setdefault(enr.section_id, []).append(enr.student)
                all_student_ids.append(enr.student_id)

        subject_logs = {
            (log['schedule_id'], log['student_id']): log['status']
            for log in SubjectAttendanceLog.objects.filter(
                attendance_date=today,
                student_id__in=all_student_ids
            ).values('schedule_id', 'student_id', 'status')
        }
        daily_logs = dict(
            DailyAttendanceSummary.objects.filter(
                attendance_date=today,
                student_id__in=all_student_ids
            ).values_list('student_id', 'status')
        )

        classes_data = []
        seen_section_ids = set()

        def build_student_items(students_list, schedule_id=None):
            items = []
            for st in students_list:
                status_val = (
                    (subject_logs.get((schedule_id, st.id)) if schedule_id else None)
                    or daily_logs.get(st.id)
                    or 'UNSCANNED'
                )
                items.append({
                    'id': st.id,
                    'lrn': str(st.lrn).strip(),
                    'full_name': format_full_student_name(st),
                    'name': format_full_student_name(st),
                    'gender': getattr(st, 'sex', ''),
                    'photo_url': resolve_student_photo_url(st, request),
                    'attendance_status': status_val,
                    'parent_contact': st.parent_contact or '',
                    'qr_token': st.qr_token or '',
                    'rfid_uid': st.rfid_uid or '',
                })
            return items

        for s in scheds_list:
            sec = s.section
            if not sec:
                continue

            sec_students = students_by_section.get(sec.id, [])
            student_items = build_student_items(sec_students, s.id)
            start_str = str(s.start_time)[:5] if s.start_time else ''
            end_str = str(s.end_time)[:5] if s.end_time else ''

            classes_data.append({
                'id': s.id,
                'schedule_id': s.id,
                'section_id': sec.id,
                'name': sec.name,
                'section_name': sec.name,
                'grade_level': sec.grade_level.name if sec.grade_level else '',
                'grade_level_code': sec.grade_level.code if sec.grade_level else '',
                'subject_code': s.subject.code if s.subject else '',
                'subject_name': s.subject.title if s.subject else '',
                'subject_title': s.subject.title if s.subject else '',
                'room': getattr(sec, 'room_number', '') or getattr(s, 'room_number', ''),
                'start_time': start_str,
                'end_time': end_str,
                'time_display': f"{start_str} - {end_str}".strip(" -"),
                'total_students': len(student_items),
                'enrolled_count': len(student_items),
                'student_count': len(student_items),
                'students': student_items,
                'is_adviser': bool(faculty and sec.adviser_id == faculty.id),
            })
            seen_section_ids.add(sec.id)

        for sec in extra_advisory:
            if sec.id in seen_section_ids:
                continue
            sec_students = students_by_section.get(sec.id, [])
            student_items = build_student_items(sec_students)

            classes_data.append({
                'id': sec.id,
                'schedule_id': sec.id,
                'section_id': sec.id,
                'name': sec.name,
                'section_name': sec.name,
                'grade_level': sec.grade_level.name if sec.grade_level else '',
                'grade_level_code': sec.grade_level.code if sec.grade_level else '',
                'subject_code': 'ADV',
                'subject_name': 'Advisory Homeroom',
                'subject_title': 'Advisory Homeroom',
                'room': getattr(sec, 'room_number', ''),
                'start_time': '07:30',
                'end_time': '16:30',
                'time_display': 'All Day',
                'total_students': len(student_items),
                'enrolled_count': len(student_items),
                'student_count': len(student_items),
                'students': student_items,
                'is_adviser': True,
            })

        return Response(classes_data, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)


MyAssignedClassesAPIView = ClassListAPIView


class FacultyClassroomListAPIView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request):
        section_id = request.query_params.get('section_id') or request.query_params.get('section')
        if not section_id:
            return ClassListAPIView().get(request)

        today = timezone.localdate()
        students = (
            Student.objects.filter(enrollments__section_id=section_id, enrollments__status='ENROLLED', is_active=True)
            .distinct()
            .order_by('last_name', 'first_name')
        )

        subject_logs = dict(
            SubjectAttendanceLog.objects.filter(student__in=students, attendance_date=today).values_list('student_id', 'status')
        )
        daily_logs = dict(
            DailyAttendanceSummary.objects.filter(student__in=students, attendance_date=today).values_list('student_id', 'status')
        )

        data = [
            {
                'id': s.id,
                'lrn': str(s.lrn).strip(),
                'name': format_full_student_name(s),
                'full_name': format_full_student_name(s),
                'gender': getattr(s, 'sex', ''),
                'photo_url': resolve_student_photo_url(s, request),
                'attendance_status': subject_logs.get(s.id) or daily_logs.get(s.id, 'UNSCANNED'),
                'parent_contact': s.parent_contact or '',
                'qr_token': s.qr_token or '',
                'rfid_uid': s.rfid_uid or '',
            }
            for s in students
        ]
        return Response(data, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)

# ============================================================================
# 4. BATCH CLASSROOM SCANNING (BULK IMPORT / MULTI-SCAN)
# ============================================================================

class ClassroomBatchScanAPIView(APIView):
    """
    Records student attendance verified by a faculty inside the classroom.
    Validates Gate Attendance:
    - If the student has NO gate scan today: Flagged as UNVERIFIED.
    - If the student's last gate scan was OUT: Flagged as CUTTING.
    - If verified inside campus via Gate scan: Confirmed as PRESENT or LATE.
    """
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    @transaction.atomic
    def post(self, request):
        serializer = ClassroomBatchScanSerializer(data=request.data)
        if not serializer.is_valid():
            return Response(serializer.errors, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)

        sched_id = serializer.validated_data['schedule_id']
        sched = Schedule.objects.select_related('section', 'subject', 'faculty').filter(id=sched_id).first()
        target_section = sched.section if sched else Section.objects.filter(id=sched_id).first()

        if not target_section and not sched:
            return Response({'error': 'Active class section not found.'}, status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND)

        today = timezone.localdate()
        today_start = timezone.make_aware(datetime.combine(today, datetime.min.time()))
        today_end = timezone.make_aware(datetime.combine(today, datetime.max.time()))

        sec_to_check = sched.section if sched else target_section
        enrolled_student_ids = set(
            Enrollment.objects.filter(section=sec_to_check, status='ENROLLED').values_list('student_id', flat=True)
        )

        today_gate_logs = (
            StudentGateLog.objects.filter(scan_time__gte=today_start, scan_time__lte=today_end)
            .order_by('student_id', '-scan_time')
            .values('student_id', 'direction')
        )
        latest_gate_dir = {}
        for gl in today_gate_logs:
            if gl['student_id'] not in latest_gate_dir:
                latest_gate_dir[gl['student_id']] = gl['direction']

        scans_data = serializer.validated_data['scans']
        clean_tokens = [sanitize_qr_token(item['qr_token']) for item in scans_data]

        matched_students = Student.objects.filter(
            Q(qr_token__in=clean_tokens) | Q(rfid_uid__in=clean_tokens) | Q(lrn__in=clean_tokens),
            is_active=True
        )

        token_to_student = {}
        for st in matched_students:
            if st.qr_token: token_to_student[st.qr_token] = st
            if st.rfid_uid: token_to_student[st.rfid_uid.upper()] = st
            if st.lrn: token_to_student[str(st.lrn).strip()] = st

        processed_records = []
        now_dt = timezone.now()
        now_time_str = timezone.localtime(now_dt).strftime('%I:%M:%S %p')
        faculty = resolve_faculty_for_user(request.user)
        if not faculty:
            faculty = FacultyProfile.objects.filter(account=request.user).first()

        for item in scans_data:
            token = sanitize_qr_token(item['qr_token'])
            target_status = str(item.get('status', 'PRESENT')).upper()
            st = token_to_student.get(token) or token_to_student.get(token.upper())

            if not st:
                continue

            is_enrolled = st.id in enrolled_student_ids
            last_gate_scan = latest_gate_dir.get(st.id)

            if not is_enrolled:
                is_anomaly = True
                final_status = 'UNVERIFIED'
                anomaly_remarks = 'Student is enrolled in a different class section.'
            elif last_gate_scan is None:
                is_anomaly = True
                final_status = 'UNVERIFIED'
                anomaly_remarks = 'FLAGGED: No gate entry recorded today. Possible fence jump or unscanned entrance.'
            elif last_gate_scan == 'OUT':
                is_anomaly = True
                final_status = 'CUTTING'
                anomaly_remarks = 'FLAGGED: Student was previously recorded exiting the campus gate.'
            else:
                is_anomaly = False
                final_status = target_status
                anomaly_remarks = 'Classroom attendance verified. Gate entry confirmed.'

            # Safe update or create Subject Attendance Log
            if sched:
                SubjectAttendanceLog.objects.update_or_create(
                    student=st,
                    schedule=sched,
                    attendance_date=today,
                    defaults={
                        'faculty': sched.faculty or faculty,
                        'status': final_status,
                        'scanned_at': now_dt,
                    }
                )

            # Update Daily Attendance Summary for web portal
            if sec_to_check:
                summary_status = final_status if final_status in ['PRESENT', 'LATE', 'CUTTING'] else 'ABSENT'
                DailyAttendanceSummary.objects.update_or_create(
                    student=st,
                    attendance_date=today,
                    defaults={
                        'section': sec_to_check,
                        'status': summary_status,
                        'remarks': anomaly_remarks[:255],
                    }
                )

            student_photo = resolve_student_photo_url(st, request)

            processed_records.append({
                'student_id': st.id,
                'name': format_full_student_name(st),
                'lrn': str(st.lrn),
                'rfid_uid': st.rfid_uid or '',
                'photo_url': student_photo,
                'photo': student_photo,
                'parent_contact': st.parent_contact or '',
                'section': sec_to_check.name if sec_to_check else '',
                'status': final_status,
                'is_anomaly': is_anomaly,
                'remarks': anomaly_remarks,
                'scan_time': now_time_str,
            })

        return Response({
            'success': True,
            'message': f"Classroom attendance recorded for {len(processed_records)} student(s).",
            'scanned_count': len(processed_records),
            'processed_records': processed_records,
        }, status=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)


# ============================================================================
# 5. ADVISER SUBJECT ATTENDANCE MATRIX
# ============================================================================

class AdviserSectionMatrixAPIView(APIView):
    """
    Returns a comprehensive subject attendance matrix for the Class Adviser.
    Shows student-by-student attendance status across all subjects today.
    """
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request):
        user = request.user
        today = timezone.localdate()
        faculty = resolve_faculty_for_user(user)
        if not faculty:
            faculty = FacultyProfile.objects.filter(account=user).first()

        is_admin = is_leadership_role(user) or user.is_superuser

        section_id = request.query_params.get('section_id')
        if section_id and is_admin:
            section = Section.objects.filter(id=section_id).first()
        elif faculty:
            section = Section.objects.filter(adviser=faculty).first()
            if not section and is_admin:
                section = Section.objects.first()
        else:
            section = None

        if not section:
            return Response({
                'has_advisory_class': False,
                'message': 'No advisory class section linked to this account.',
                'schedules': [],
                'matrix': []
            }, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)

        schedules = Schedule.objects.filter(
            section=section
        ).select_related('subject', 'faculty').order_by('start_time')

        schedule_headers = [
            {
                'schedule_id': s.id,
                'subject_code': s.subject.code if s.subject else 'HOMEROOM',
                'subject_name': s.subject.title if s.subject else 'Advisory Homeroom',
                'faculty_name': s.faculty.full_name if s.faculty else 'Unassigned',
                'time_window': f"{str(s.start_time)[:5]} - {str(s.end_time)[:5]}" if s.start_time else 'All Day',
            }
            for s in schedules
        ]

        enrollments = Enrollment.objects.filter(
            section=section,
            status='ENROLLED',
            student__is_active=True
        ).select_related('student').order_by('student__last_name', 'student__first_name')

        students = [e.student for e in enrollments if e.student]
        student_ids = [s.id for s in students]

        subject_logs = SubjectAttendanceLog.objects.filter(
            attendance_date=today,
            student_id__in=student_ids
        ).values('student_id', 'schedule_id', 'status', 'scan_time')

        log_map = {}
        for entry in subject_logs:
            key = (entry['student_id'], entry['schedule_id'])
            log_map[key] = {
                'status': entry['status'],
                'scan_time': entry['scan_time'].strftime('%I:%M %p') if entry['scan_time'] else ''
            }

        today_start = timezone.make_aware(datetime.combine(today, datetime.min.time()))
        today_end = timezone.make_aware(datetime.combine(today, datetime.max.time()))

        gate_logs = StudentGateLog.objects.filter(
            student_id__in=student_ids,
            scan_time__gte=today_start,
            scan_time__lte=today_end
        ).order_by('student_id', '-scan_time').values('student_id', 'direction', 'scan_time')

        latest_gate = {}
        for gl in gate_logs:
            if gl['student_id'] not in latest_gate:
                latest_gate[gl['student_id']] = {
                    'direction': gl['direction'],
                    'time': gl['scan_time'].strftime('%I:%M %p')
                }

        matrix_rows = []
        for idx, st in enumerate(students, start=1):
            subjects_attended = 0
            subjects_cutting = 0
            subject_details = []

            for s in schedules:
                record = log_map.get((st.id, s.id))
                if record:
                    st_status = record['status']
                    scan_t = record['scan_time']
                    if st_status in ['PRESENT', 'LATE']:
                        subjects_attended += 1
                    elif st_status == 'CUTTING':
                        subjects_cutting += 1
                else:
                    st_status = 'UNSCANNED'
                    scan_t = ''

                subject_details.append({
                    'schedule_id': s.id,
                    'subject_code': s.subject.code if s.subject else 'HOMEROOM',
                    'status': st_status,
                    'time': scan_t,
                })

            gate_info = latest_gate.get(st.id)
            gate_display = (
                f"Entered at {gate_info['time']}" if gate_info and gate_info['direction'] == 'IN'
                else (f"Exited at {gate_info['time']}" if gate_info and gate_info['direction'] == 'OUT' else "No Gate Scan")
            )

            total_subjects = len(schedules)
            compliance_rate = round((subjects_attended / total_subjects) * 100) if total_subjects > 0 else 0

            matrix_rows.append({
                'number': idx,
                'student_id': st.id,
                'student_name': format_full_student_name(st),
                'lrn': str(st.lrn),
                'photo_url': resolve_student_photo_url(st, request),
                'gate_status': gate_display,
                'gate_direction': gate_info['direction'] if gate_info else 'NONE',
                'attended_count': subjects_attended,
                'cutting_count': subjects_cutting,
                'total_subjects': total_subjects,
                'compliance_rate': compliance_rate,
                'subjects': subject_details,
            })

        return Response({
            'has_advisory_class': True,
            'section_id': section.id,
            'section_name': section.name,
            'grade_level': section.grade_level.name if section.grade_level else '',
            'total_students': len(students),
            'schedules': schedule_headers,
            'matrix': matrix_rows,
        }, status=status.HTTP_200_OK)

"""
